chinese: 每 0.7 秒落下一波飞刃
english: A Volley of blades falls every 0.7 seconds

chinese: 召唤一把赤色镰刀横扫选择的区域，对敌人造成物理伤害，并附加持续物理伤害的减益效果。如果有敌人幸存，你获得 1 个赤炼球，它可以同时提高技能的消耗和伤害。玩家最多可以有 5 个赤炼球。
english: A bloody scythe swipes across a selected area, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.

chinese: 召唤一把赤色镰刀环绕挥舞，对敌人造成物理伤害，并附加持续物理伤害减益效果。如果有敌人幸存，你获得 1 个赤炼球，同时提高技能的消耗和伤害。玩家最多可以有 5 个赤炼球。
english: A bloody scythe swipes around you, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.

chinese: 一道贝达特的闪电击中一片区域，造成闪电伤害。
english: A bolt of Beidat's lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage.

chinese: 使用雷击攻击一个区域, 造成闪电伤害.
english: A bolt of lightning strikes an area, dealing lightning damage.

chinese: 喷发出一道火焰, 造成火焰伤害.
english: A burst of flame errupts from the location of a hit, dealing fire damage.

chinese: 从施法者散发出一圈寒冰之环，并在每位被击中的敌人身上再次散发。
english: A chilling circle of ice expands from the caster, repeating from every enemy it hits.

chinese: 从施法者散发出一圈寒冰之环。
english: A circle of ice expands from the caster.

chinese: 从施法者散发出一圈寒冰之环。如果施法者目标在寒冰弹附近，冰环就会在冰弹处扩散。如果该技能通过此方式重复触发，则会在短暂延迟后在相同冰弹处再次扩散。
english: A circle of ice expands from the caster. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will expand from a number of those projectiles instead. If this skill would repeat when cast this way, it will instead expand again from the same projectiles after a short delay.

chinese: 目标附近的灵柩爆炸造成小范围伤害，并召唤一个自动追踪敌人的火球，可以造成较大范围的法术伤害。灵柩爆炸造成的伤害无法被法术伤害词缀加成，并且无法被反射。
english: A corpse near the targeted location explodes, dealing damage in a small area and creating an orb which moves towards nearby enemies before dealing spell damage in a larger area. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

chinese: 固定数量的火焰之箭呈螺旋状落下，并最终击中目标位置。它们在落地时会产生爆炸，对附近的敌人造成伤害，并留下燃烧的地面，持续造成火焰伤害。
english: A fixed number of flaming bolts rain down in a spiral, culminating in the central one impacting the targeted location. They explode when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies and leaving burning ground, which deals fire damage over time.

chinese: 从天空召唤一块巨大的深渊魂石水晶，坠落并砸击目标地点。
english: A giant crystal of abyssal soulstone is called from above, falling to slam down at the targeted location.

chinese: 低语呢喃，呼唤一枚巨大的火焰之球向目标区域撞击。火球落地时将会爆炸，并对周围的敌人造成伤害。
english: A large flaming bolt falls towards the targeted area. The bolt explodes when landing, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

chinese:
使用被辅助法术时，每支付 200 点预支生命消耗，
周围的一个召唤生物就会获得一个灵魂
english:
A nearby Minion gains a Soul for every 200 Life you spend on Upfront
Costs with Supported Spells

chinese: 一道感电电弧从施放者射向目标，并会弹射至其他敌人。每次主电弧弹射至一个敌人时，还会同时影响两个远处的敌人，但不会影响已经被任意弹射击中的敌人。同时提供一个增益，使你的电弧伤害在短时间内特别幸运。
english: A shocking arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains from an enemy, it will do so simultaneously to two further enemies, but never to enemies that have already been hit by any of these chains. Also grants a buff making your Arc damage lucky for a short duration.

chinese: 使目标灵柩爆炸，造成范围伤害并转化为一个熔火喷泉。它将在一段时间内持续向周围放出投射物并引爆周围的灵柩。灵柩的爆炸无法被法术伤害词缀加成，并且无法被反射。
english: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area and detonate nearby corpses for a duration. Corpse explosions are not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

chinese: 使目标灵柩爆炸，造成范围伤害并转化为一个熔火喷泉。它将在一段时间内持续向周围放出投射物。灵柩的爆炸无法被法术伤害词缀加成，并且无法被反射。
english: A targeted corpse explodes, dealing area damage and turning into a volcanic geyser, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration. The explosion of the corpse is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected.

chinese: 一只蟾蜍跃向敌人并爆炸，对一片区域造成法术伤害。
english: A toad leaps towards enemies and explodes, dealing spell damage in an area.

chinese: 从被击杀敌人的灵柩中召唤一只蟾蜍，它会扑向敌人并爆炸，造成相当于被击杀敌人生命值 40% 的混沌伤害。此技能的伤害不受法术伤害加成影响，且无法被反射。
english: A toad spawns from the corpse of the slain enemy, leaps towards enemies and explodes, dealing forty percent of the slain enemy's Life as Chaos Damage. This skill's damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.

chinese: 一股神圣的波涌对一条线上的敌人造成伤害，随后创造奉献地面，并对目标位置周围的区域造成伤害。然后向外发射一股更大的冲击波，对置身于奉献地面中，但没有被击中的敌人造成伤害。
english: A wave of divine fire deals damage in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground and deals damage in an area around the targeted location. A larger shockwave then expands outwards, damaging enemies standing on Consecrated Ground that were not already hit.

chinese: 伏击
english: Ambush

chinese: 一道电弧从施放者射向目标，并会弹射至其他敌人，但不会立刻向原目标弹射。每次主电弧弹射时，也会向另一个主电弧尚未击中的敌人发射次电弧，次电弧不能再连锁弹射。
english: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies, but not immediately back. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy that the main arc has not already hit, which cannot chain further.

chinese: 一道电弧从施放者射向目标，并会弹射至其他敌人。每次主电弧弹射时，也会向另一个敌人发射次电弧，次电弧不能再连锁弹射。
english: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and chains to other enemies. Each time the arc chains, it will also chain a secondary arc to another enemy, but this secondary arc cannot chain further.

chinese: 一道电弧从施放者射向目标并分裂，同时击中附近的多个敌人。
english: An arc of lightning reaches from the caster to a targeted enemy and splits to simultaneously hit several other enemies.

chinese: 一股逐渐拓展的能量波向前涌动，在一段时间内对锥形范围内的敌人造成伤害。被击中的每个敌人会根据受到的最高伤害的类型，遭受一个该元素的曝露负面效果。一次只能激活一个定罪波。
english: An expanding wave of energy surges forward, damaging enemies in a cone-shaped area over a duration. Each enemy hit is inflicted with Exposure matching the element of which they took the highest damage. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time

chinese: 一股逐渐拓展的能量波从你身上向外涌动，在一段时间内对环形区域内的敌人造成伤害。随后环形在返回途中再次对敌人造成伤害。一次只能激活一个定罪波。
english: An expanding wave of energy surges outwards from you, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration. The ring then returns, damaging enemies again on the way back. Only one Wave of Conviction can be active at a time

chinese: 一个会在施法者周围爆炸的冰爆，对敌人造成冰霜伤害，并留下一个漩涡，对于在其中的敌人继续造成持续冰霜伤害和冰缓。
english: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it.

chinese: 一个会在施法者周围爆炸的冰爆，对敌人造成冰霜伤害，并留下一个漩涡，对于在其中的敌人继续造成持续冰霜伤害和冰缓。若施法目标区域附近存在着寒冰弹，冰爆则会出现在寒冰弹的位置。
english: An icy blast explodes around the caster, dealing cold damage to enemies, and leaving behind a whirling vortex which deals cold damage over time and chills enemies caught in it. If the caster targets near their Frostbolt projectiles, it will explode from a number of those projectiles instead, destroying them.

chinese: 发出一个半月形的寒冰投射物, 被击中的敌人将有几率被冰冻. 这个投射物很快就会消散, 而其伤害与冻结几率将会随着飞行时间递减.
english: An icy projectile which has a chance to freeze enemies it passes through. The projectile fades quickly, reducing damage and freezing chance until it dissipates.

chinese: 为一位隐形守卫幻化一把近战武器或一件护甲，使其为你而战，它会使用圣裁之惩击并忽略武器限制。可以为同一个守卫附加多个幻化物品。无法为其幻化未鉴定的物品。无法用于陷阱或地雷。如果守卫被击败，你无法再该地图再次召唤幻化守卫。
english: Animates a melee weapon or armour, attaching it to an invisible Guardian that fights by your side using Smite of Divine Judgement, ignoring weapon restrictions. Animating multiple items attaches them to the same Guardian. You cannot animate unidentified items. Cannot be used by Traps or Mines. If your Guardian dies you cannot summon an Animated Guardian again in that area.

chinese: 施加增益效果，提高感电几率。在拥有此增益效果的情况下使敌人感电时，会在感电的敌人身上产生一个球形能量场，并使敌人持续感电一段时间，其闪电束会对该敌人和附近的其他敌人造成伤害。
english: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning.

chinese: 施加增益效果，提高感电几率。在拥有此增益效果的情况下使敌人感电时，会在感电的敌人身上产生一个球形能量场，并使敌人持续感电一段时间，其闪电束会对该敌人和附近的其他敌人造成伤害。能量场的强度取决于形成能量场时对敌人造成影响的感电程度。
english: Applies a buff boosting chance to shock. When you shock an enemy while you have this buff, creates a spherical field of energy attached to the shocked enemy for a duration, which will damage it and other nearby enemies with beams of lightning. The strength of the field depends on the magnitude of shock affecting the enemy when it is created.

chinese: 施加一个增益效果，增加护甲值，并在耗尽前替你承担部分伤害。当该增益效果时间结束或耗尽时，该技能将基于该增益效果承受的总伤害，把伤害反射给周围的敌人。与其它防卫技能共用冷却时间。
english: Applies a buff that adds to your armour, and can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. When the buff expires or is depleted, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken from the buff. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

chinese: 施加一个增益效果，在你生命低于一半时提供保护，防止被击中时立刻失去生命，改为随时间缓慢失去生命值。在该增益效果下，你无法通过除药剂外的手段将生命恢复至高于低血状态，并且一旦生命高于低血状态，施放技能时会同时消耗生命和魔力。
english: Applies a buff that protects the lower half of your life, preventing some of the immediate life loss when damaged by hits and applying the loss over time instead. Your life cannot be raised above low life other than by flasks, and while above low life, skills will cost life as well as mana.

chinese: 施加一个增益效果，提升护甲值，并在耗尽前替你承担部分伤害。该技能每秒都会向周围敌人反射伤害，其数值由反射时那一秒受到的伤害来决定。增益效果结束时，该技能会基于增益效果累计受到的总伤害对你周围的敌人反射伤害。你在具有其它防卫技能时不能获得该增益效果。
english: Applies a buff that raises your armour, and takes some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Each second, the skill deals reflected damage to surrounding enemies based on the damage taken by the buff in that second. When the buff is removed, the skill deals reflected damage to enemies around you based on the total damage that was taken by the buff. You cannot have the buff at the same time as any other Guard skill.

chinese: 给你和你的每个召唤生物施加一个增益效果，在其耗尽之前替你承受部分敌人的击中伤害。该增益效果还免疫流血。和其它防卫技能共用冷却时间。
english: Applies a buff to you and each of your minions, which will take some of the damage from enemy hits before being depleted. The buff also grants immunity to bleeding. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

chinese: 施加一个增益效果，在其耗尽之前替你承受部分伤害。和其它防卫技能共用冷却时间。
english: Applies a buff which can take some of the damage from hits for you before being depleted. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

chinese: 对敌人施加一个减益, 移除他们部分混沌抗性.
english: Applies a debuff to Enemies, removing some of their resistance to Chaos damage.

chinese: 给一个指定的敌人施加减益效果，使你的召唤生物把它当作掠食目标。所有由【掠食】辅助的技能产生的召唤生物都会以它为目标。你一次只能有一个【掠食信标】。该技能不能用于图腾、陷阱和地雷。
english: Applies a debuff to a specific enemy which signals your minions to consider that enemy to be the Prey. All minions from skills supported by any Predator Support will target that enemy. Only one enemy can be the Prey at a time. This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 对一小片区域里的敌人施加减益效果，造成持续混沌伤害，并把连接的魔蛊技能施加给它们。通过这种方式每施加一种魔蛊，就能使该减益效果的伤害更高，持续越久。该技能不能用于图腾、陷阱和地雷。
english: Applies a debuff to enemies in a small area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

english: Applies a debuff to enemies in an area, which deals chaos damage over Time. Linked hex curses are also applied to those enemies. The debuff deals more damage and lasts longer for each hex applied this way.  This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 对前方锥形范围内的敌人造成减益效果，持续造成混沌伤害。尚未被枯萎影响的敌人也会受到较长时间的间接阻碍，降低他们的移动速度和生命再生速度。持续吟唱叠加的伤害减益效果有独自的持续时间。
english: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a longer secondary duration, slowing their movement and reducing their life regeneration rate. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

chinese: 持续吟唱该技能会对前方锥形范围内的敌人造成一个可叠加的减益效果和持续混沌伤害. 当敌人刚被法术命中时会被短暂的减速. 每层可叠加的减益和伤害都有独自的持续时间.
english: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration.

chinese: 对前方的敌人造成减益效果，持续造成混沌伤害。当敌人刚被法术命中时会受到短暂的缓速，降低移动速度。持续吟唱叠加的伤害减益效果有独自的持续时间。伤害减益效果可由【瘟疫】传染。
english: Apply a debuff to enemies in front of you which deals chaos damage over time. Enemies who aren't already debuffed by Blight are also hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement. Continued channelling adds layers of damage to the debuff, each with their own duration. The damaging debuff is spread by Contagion.

chinese: 对你周围的敌人施加一个强力的减益效果，持续对其造成混沌伤害。随后在一片较大的区域内施加额外两层，每一次施加都会大幅扩大面积。被主要作用区域影响的敌人还会遭受短时间的减速效果。
english: Apply a powerful debuff to enemies around you which deals chaos damage over time. Then applies two additional layers in a larger area, growing greatly in size each time. Enemies are also substantially hindered for a shorter secondary duration, slowing their movement.

english: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike that also hurts you. Successive uses will raise the damage dealt both to enemies and you. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

english: Attack enemies with a forceful melee strike. Stunning an enemy with the strike releases a damaging pulse. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe or Staff.

chinese: 大幅增加攻击范围，击中时产生一片冰缓区域，持续造成冰霜伤害。限定近战武器。
english: Attack enemies with greatly increased range, creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time if it hits. Requires a Melee Weapon.

chinese: 增加攻击范围。当被第一个被击飞的敌人与其他敌人碰撞时释放冰霜之刃。限定近战武器。
english: Attack enemies with increased range, releasing icy blades from the first enemy hit which fly at other enemies. Requires a Melee Weapon.

chinese: 使用近战武器攻击，击中敌人则在一段时间内获得一层聚雷增益效果。拥有聚雷效果时，该技能的攻击会引发连锁闪电光束，聚雷层数越高，连锁次数越多。
english: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining a Gathering Lightning buff for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have Gathering Lightning, attacks with this skill will cause chaining beams of lightning, which chain additional times the more Gathering Lightning you have.

chinese: 使用近战武器攻击，击中敌人则在一段时间内获得静电场。它会用光束频繁地击中周围一定数量的敌人，造成攻击伤害。
english: Attack with a melee weapon, gaining static energy for a duration if you hit an enemy. While you have static energy, you'll frequently hit a number of nearby enemies with beams, dealing attack damage.

chinese: 攻击前方一片区域。击中敌人的每道冲击波都会积累阶段，只要短期内没有击中任何目标就会失去阶段。限定匕首，爪类，单手剑。
english: Attacks an area in front of you. Each Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

chinese: 对敌人进行一次强力攻击。限定锤类、短杖、斧类，剑类或长杖。
english: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Sword or Staff.

chinese: 对敌人进行一次强力攻击。需要长杖发动。
english: Attacks enemies with a forceful blow. Requires a Staff.

chinese: 近战攻击敌人，在短期内施加一个减益效果。如果非传奇敌人在受到该效果影响时击败，则会消耗它的灵柩创造一个统御哨兵，具有相同稀有度、前缀和后缀，并持续一段更长的时间。
english: Attacks enemies with a melee strike, applying a debuff for a short duration. If a non-unique enemy dies while affected by the debuff, the enemy's corpse will be consumed and a Sentinel of Dominance with the same rarity, prefix and suffix modifiers will be summoned for a longer secondary duration.

chinese: 使用一次强力的近战攻击打击敌人并获得防御效果，降低你受到的伤害。可以通过消耗一个耐力球来跳过冷却时间。需要近战武器。
english: Attacks enemies with a powerful melee strike which grants Fortification, reducing damage you take from hits. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Requires a Melee Weapon.

chinese: 使用两把武器对目标同时进行攻击并造成伤害. 限定双持（不包含法杖）.
english: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Dual wield only. Does not work with wands.

chinese: 使用两把武器对目标同时进行攻击并造成伤害。限定双持两种不同类型的近战武器。
english: Attacks with both weapons, dealing the damage of both in one strike. Requires dual-wielding two different melee weapon types to use.

chinese: 用武器攻击敌人，施加一个有层数的主减益效果，并对击中的其它敌人附加一个不带层数的次要减益效果。主减益效果叠满 6 层、自然消减或带有该效果的敌人被击败时被消除，对该敌人及周围其它敌人造成伤害。其它带有次要减益效果的敌人被击败时也会爆炸，对周围敌人造成伤害。爆炸造成的伤害无法被反射。限定剑类、斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖或是空手。
english: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to enemies hit by your strike, and an uncharged debuff to any other enemies hit. Upon reaching 6 charges, expiring, or the enemy's death, the charged debuff is removed to damage that and other surrounding enemies. Enemies with either debuff explode when they die, damaging other surrounding enemies. Damage from this explosion cannot be reflected. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 用武器攻击敌人，该技能初次击中敌人时施加一个有层数的减益效果。减益效果叠满 6 层或自然消减时被消除，对周围敌人造成伤害。限定剑类、斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖或是空手。
english: Attacks with your weapon, applying a charged debuff to you the first time you hit an enemy with this skill. Upon reaching 6 charges, or charges expiring, the charged debuff is removed to damage nearby enemies. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 用武器发动攻击，击中给敌人施加一个减益效果。一旦具有该减益效果的敌人中毒而败，致疫打击就会给它周围的敌人施加第二重减益效果，基于被击败的敌人身上的中毒造成混沌持续伤害。该伤害不受伤害词缀影响。限定爪类和匕首。
english: Attacks with your weapon, inflicting a debuff on enemies hit by the strike. If a debuffed enemy dies while poisoned, Pestilent Strike inflicts a secondary chaos damage over time debuff on enemies around them, based on the poisons on the slain enemy. This damage is not affected by your damage modifiers. Requires a Claw or Dagger.

chinese: 暴击时施放(辅)
english: Cast On Critical Strike

chinese: 施放一道契约，强化发射投射物、对目标地点施加范围效果或发射连锁光束的非持续吟唱法术，使其造成更多伤害并拥有更广的覆盖范围。然而，使用此技能也会为你施加 1 项苦痛。
english: Cast a pact, Empowering non-channelling spells that either fire projectiles, apply an effect to an area around a targeted location or fire chaining beams, causing them to deal more damage and have enhanced coverage. However, using this skill also burdens you with an Affliction.

chinese: 施放一道契约，强化你接下来自己施放的持续吟唱法术，但同时为你施加一项苦痛。被强化的法术在吟唱期间造成更多伤害，并周期性触发闪电箭。
english: Cast a pact, Empowering the next channelling spells you cast yourself but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered spells deal more damage and periodically trigger lightning bolts while channelling.

chinese: 施放一道契约，强化你的持续伤害法术，但会为你施加一项苦痛。此技能还会在一段时间内赋予咕尔饥渴增益，使血肉撕裂周期性触发。
english: Cast a pact, Empowering your damage over time spells but burdening you with an Affliction. This skill also grants the Hunger of Ghorr buff for a duration causing Fleshrend to trigger periodically.

chinese: 施放一道契约，强化你的伤害性瓦尔法术，但同时为你施加 1 项苦痛。被强化的瓦尔法术造成更多伤害，阻灵术时间缩短，并在使用时返还消耗的灵魂。
english: Cast a pact, Empowering your damaging Vaal spells but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered Vaal spells deal more damage, have less soul gain prevention duration and regain consumed souls on use.

chinese: 死亡时施放(辅)
english: Cast on Death

chinese: 近战击败时施放(辅)
english: Cast on Melee Kill

chinese: 结界破碎时释放（辅）
english: Cast on Ward Break

chinese: 受伤时施放(辅)
english: Cast when Damage Taken

chinese: 晕眩时施放(辅)
english: Cast when Stunned

chinese: 吟唱时施放(辅)
english: Cast while Channelling

chinese: 施放一个增益效果，基于不同的姿态给近战技能施加不同的加成。再次使用该技能会在血姿态和沙姿态之间切换。
english: Casts a buff that grants different bonuses to melee skills depending on your stance. Using the skill again alternates between Blood Stance and Sand Stance.

chinese: 施放一个对敌人造成虚弱的范围效果, 造成缓速并且叠加一个使他们增加受到的混沌伤害之减益效果. 此减益效果可叠加 15 层.
english: Casts a debilitating debuff on enemies in an area, hindering their movement and also inflicts the Withered debuff, which increases the Chaos Damage they take and can stack up to 15 times.

chinese: 在指定位置施放一个法阵, 在数秒之后将周围的敌人传送过去. 当传送时, 在原本位置与传送法阵位置的敌人都会受到闪电伤害.
english: Casts a delayed teleport for nearby enemies to a target destination. When the teleport occurs, lightning damage is dealt to the enemies both before and after they teleport.

chinese: 从施法者散发出一圈闪电之环, 接着散发出更大范围的一圈闪电之环. 每次被击中的敌人会受到闪电伤害.
english: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage.

chinese: 在你周围施放一圈闪电之环，随后释放一道更大的闪电新星。每个效果都会以闪电伤害命中其作用范围内的敌人。此过程将重复进行，且每次重复都会朝你瞄准的方向偏移。
english: Casts a ring of Lightning around you, followed by a larger Lightning nova. Each effect hits enemies caught in their area with Lightning Damage. This then repeats, with each repeat offset from the previous in the direction you target.

chinese: 施放一个光环，让你和友军在短时间内有额外几率避开攻击，并被压制的法术伤害对你特别不幸。
english: Casts a temporary aura that grants you and your allies additional chance to evade attacks, and makes suppressed spell damage unlucky against you.

chinese: 施放一个短暂的光环, 使你与受光环影响友军获得额外移动速度, 攻击速度以及施法速度.
english: Casts a temporary aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个短暂的光环，使你与受光环影响友军施放技能时无须消耗魔力.
english: Casts a temporary aura that lets you and your allies cast skills without paying their mana costs.

chinese: 施放一个短暂的光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得额外的能量护盾，并且不会因为受到攻击而延迟护盾的回复.
english: Casts a temporary aura that prevents energy shield recharge being delayed by damage taken for you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军在攻击和施放法术时额外附带混沌伤害.
english: Casts an aura that adds chaos damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军在攻击和施放法术时额外附带火焰伤害.
english: Casts an aura that adds fire damage to the attacks and spells of you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环, 使你与受光环影响友军在攻击时额外附带闪电伤害, 并且造成更多法术闪电伤害.
english: Casts an aura that adds lightning damage to the attacks of you and your allies, and makes your spells deal more lightning damage.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你周围的敌人受到的物理伤害提高。
english: Casts an aura that causes nearby enemies to take more physical damage.

chinese: 施展治愈你和友方的灵气，治愈量等同所受的元素伤害量。
english: Casts an aura that causes taking elemental damage to heal you and nearby allies instead.

chinese: 施放一个光环对周围敌人造成持续混沌伤害. 该技能无法被图腾施放.
english: Casts an aura that deals Chaos Damage over Time to nearby Enemies. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得命中和暴击几率。
english: Casts an aura that grants accuracy and critical strike chance to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得额外的能量护盾.
english: Casts an aura that grants additional energy shield and increased energy shield recharge rate to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得额外的护甲.
english: Casts an aura that grants armour to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环, 使你与受光环影响的友军获得伤害和法术暴击几率加成，并在面对强大敌人时有几率创造奉献地面。
english: Casts an aura that grants bonuses to damage and critical strike chance of spells to you and your allies, and gives a chance to create Consecrated Ground against stronger enemies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响的友军获得额外的冰霜抗性.
english: Casts an aura that grants cold resistance to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环, 为你和友军提供元素抗性，并免疫元素异常状态。
english: Casts an aura that grants elemental resistances and elemental ailment immunity to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得额外的闪避.
english: Casts an aura that grants evasion to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得额外冰霜伤害.
english: Casts an aura that grants extra cold damage based on physical damage to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响的友军获得额外的火焰抗性.
english: Casts an aura that grants fire resistance to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得额外的生命回复.
english: Casts an aura that grants life regeneration to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响的友军获得额外的闪电抗性.
english: Casts an aura that grants lightning resistance to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军获得额外的魔力回复.
english: Casts an aura that grants mana regeneration to you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环, 使你与受光环影响友军获得额外的移动速度, 攻击速度以及施法速度.
english: Casts an aura that increases the movement speed, attack speed and cast speed of you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你与受光环影响友军造成的持续伤害叠加，技能效果延长。
english: Casts an aura that multiplies damage over time and increases skill effect duration of you and your allies.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你和周围友军受到的冰霜伤害降低，并免疫冰缓效果，并在击中周围敌人时无视他们的冰霜抗性。
english: Casts an aura that reduces cold damage taken and provides freeze and chill immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their cold resistance.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你和周围友军受到的火焰伤害降低，并免疫点燃效果，并在击中周围敌人时无视他们的火焰抗性。
english: Casts an aura that reduces fire damage taken and provides ignite immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their fire resistance.

chinese: 施放一个光环，使你和周围友军受到的闪电伤害降低，并免疫感电效果，并在击中周围敌人时无视他们的闪电抗性。
english: Casts an aura that reduces lightning damage taken and provides shock immunity to you and nearby allies, and makes hits against nearby enemies ignore their lightning resistance.

chinese: 使你周围的地面爆发出白骨尖刺。当你使用猛击击打它们时，这些尖刺会爆炸，对周围区域造成伤害，并施加流血。
english: Cause spires of bone to erupt from the earth around you. When you use a slam on them, these spires will explode to deal damage in an area and inflicting bleeding.

chinese: 持续吟唱该技能，向指定地点旋转移动，持续攻击你周围的敌人。持续吟唱该技能时，你无法被击退。
english: Channel this skill to move towards a targeted location while spinning constantly attacking enemies in an area around you. While channelling this skill, you cannot be knocked back.

chinese: 吟唱该技能会不断保留生命，为你身下的印记灌注力量。施放印记会根据保留的生命量造成物理伤害。不能被图腾施放。
english: Channel this skill to reserve more and more of your life, building up power in a marker on the ground under you. Release to deal physical damage in an area based on how much life you reserved. Cannot be cast by Totems.

chinese: 持续吟唱给弓箭充能，积累层数。释放时，每层都会触发一种被辅助的弓类技能。若没有任何被辅助的技能，又至少积累了一层效果，则该技能会发射它原本的箭矢。无法用于图腾。
english: Channel to charge up your bow, gaining stages. Release to trigger one supported bow skill for each stage gained. If there are no supported skills, but at least one stage was gained, this skill will fire its own arrow instead. Cannot be used by Totems.

chinese: 吟唱后在你上方生成一个光球，向周围敌人发射投射物，接触地面后会爆炸。吟唱时间越长，技能等阶越高。停止吟唱后，等阶会持续消退。
english: Channel to conjure an orb above you, which pelts nearby enemies with projectiles that impact the ground and explode. Channelling for longer builds up stages on the skill. When you stop channelling, the stages decay over a duration.

chinese: 在周身引导并创造一个不断拓展的圆环区域，身处其中的敌人将被致盲。当你停止引导时，对圆环较小区域内的所有敌人造成伤害。限定匕首、爪类、或单手剑。
english: Channel to create an expanding circle area around you that blinds enemies within it. When you stop channelling, deals damage in a smaller area around each enemy in the circle. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

chinese: 持续吟唱，根据你吟唱该技能消耗的魔力来强化【缚雷之纹】放置的符纹。释放会引爆目标地点的符纹，并同时连锁引爆其它符纹。
english: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction.

chinese: 持续吟唱，根据你吟唱该技能消耗的魔力来强化【缚雷之纹】放置的符纹。释放会引爆目标地点的符纹，并同时连锁引爆其它符纹。引爆可将你传送到目标符纹处。
english: Channel to improve runes placed by Stormbind based on the mana you spend channelling this skill. Release to detonate the targeted rune, which will cause other runes to detonate in a chain reaction. Detonation can teleport you to the targeted Rune.

chinese: 通过吟唱给一支箭矢灌注混沌能量，可以蓄力积累阶数。将其发射后，飞行轨迹上会投下孢囊。每个孢囊都会绽放，喷射荆棘之箭，飞行一小段时间后消失。产生额外投射物的词缀只可以影响最初的箭矢数量，产生的孢囊会由箭矢均分。
english: Channel to infuse an arrow with chaos, gaining stages while it is held. Release to fire it, leaving spore pods in its wake. Each spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, and the spore pods will be divided between those arrows.

chinese: 持续吟唱以向你朝向的方向投射一个幻象。幻象移动时你获得层数，直至其移动到最大距离为止。幻象行进的路径上会根据你的攻击速度来频繁爆发范围伤害。停止吟唱以释放该幻象，造成最后一波伤害。需要近战武器。
english: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to release the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.

chinese: 向你朝向的方向吟唱并发射一个幻象。幻象移动时你获得层数，直至其移动到最大距离为止。幻象行进的路径上会根据你的攻击速度来频繁爆发范围伤害。停止吟唱后可将自己传送至幻象处，并以一波伤害作为技能收尾。需要近战武器。
english: Channel to project an illusion which you steer. You gain stages while it moves, until it stops at a maximum total distance. Waves of area damage frequently pulse along its path, based on your attack speed. Stop channelling to teleport to the illusion, dealing a final wave of damage. Requires a Melee Weapon.

chinese: 持续吟唱，在地上不断扩大的结界中扩散符纹。符纹持续一段时间后消失，或者被【爆裂符纹】引爆，立刻朝四面八方造成伤害。站立在符纹上的敌人会被【缓速】，并降低移动速度。
english: Channel to spread runes on the ground in a growing pattern. The runes fade away after a duration, or will be immediately removed and deal damage in a circular area when detonated by Rune Blast. Enemies standing on the runes are Hindered, reducing their movement speed.

chinese: 持续吟唱时会在你的周围汇聚能量，不断堆叠，对周围的一群敌人造成伤害。释放此技能会在你周围产生一次冲击，并在面前射出一道光束。效果范围词缀不影响该光束。最多叠加 10 层。
english: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a burst around you and a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect the beam. Maximum of 10 Stages.

chinese: 持续吟唱时会在你的周围汇聚能量，不断堆叠，对周围的一群敌人造成伤害。释放此技能会在你周围产生一次强大的冲击。最多叠加 10 层。
english: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages, damaging a number of nearby enemies when you do so. Release to unleash this energy in a powerful burst around you. Maximum of 10 Stages.

chinese: 持续吟唱时会在你的周围汇聚能量，不断堆叠。释放此技能会在你面前射出一道光束。效果范围词缀不影响该技能。最多叠加 10 层。
english: Channelling draws in energy around you to repeatedly build up stages. Release to unleash this energy in a beam in front of you. Modifiers to area of effect do not affect this skill. Maximum of 10 Stages.

chinese: 持续吟唱, 法术, 辅助
english: Channelling, Spell, Support

chinese: 持续吟唱来施放大型的爆炸。吟唱的时间越长，爆炸的范围与造成的伤害越大。停止使用该技能变会触发爆炸。
english: Channels to build up a large explosion, which is released when you stop using the skill. The longer you channel, the larger the area of effect and damage of the explosion.

chinese: 消耗一具灵柩，牺牲你的一部分生命，根据牺牲量给予你的召唤生物生命再生以及伤害加成的效果。技能会消耗附近的灵柩，每消耗一具灵柩就会增加持续时间和生命再生。
english: Consumes a corpse, and sacrifices a portion of your life, granting your minions life regeneration based on the life sacrificed, and a bonus to damage. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration and life regeneration for each corpse consumed.

chinese: 献祭一具灵柩, 使你的召唤生物获得格挡攻击与法术的能力. 这个技能会持续献祭附近的灵柩, 每具献祭的灵柩将会延长强化召唤生物的时间.
english: Consumes a corpse, granting all of your minions the power to block both attacks and spells. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

chinese: 消耗一具灵柩，提高你的召唤生物的暴击率，赋予它额外的暴击伤害加成效果。技能会消耗附近的灵柩，每消耗一具灵柩就会增加持续时间。
english: Consumes a corpse, granting increased critical strike chance and additional critical strike multiplier to your minions. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

chinese: 献祭一具灵柩, 短暂的强化与加速你的召唤生物. 这个技能会持续献祭附近的灵柩, 每具献祭的灵柩将会延长强化召唤生物的时间.
english: Consumes a corpse, which temporarily empowers your minions with swiftness. The skill consumes other nearby corpses, increasing the duration for each corpse consumed.

chinese: 消耗一个精神能量球发射一个投射物并造成物理伤害。

chinese: 持续从手中发出烈焰洪流，反复对敌人造成伤害。你吟唱此法术时间越长，烈焰在你近身的面积就越广，在你前方的波及范围就越长。
english: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you.

chinese: 持续从手中发出烈焰洪流，反复对敌人造成伤害。你吟唱此法术时间越长，烈焰在你近身的面积就越广，在你前方的波及范围就越长。当你停止吟唱，则在大范围内释放一道移动缓慢的火焰伤害波，并附加强大的点燃效果。
english: Continuously launches a torrent of fire from your hand, repeatedly damaging enemies. As you channel this spell longer, the flames spread wider close to you and spread longer directly in front of you. When you stop channelling you release a slow-moving wave of fire damage over a very large area that will apply a powerful Ignite.

english: Counts total Power of Enemies and Allies in Range

english: Counts total Power of Enemies and Corpses in Range

english: Counts total Power of Enemies in Range

english: Crab Totem

english: Crackling Lance of Branching

chinese: 瓦解之霹雳长枪
english: Crackling Lance of Disintegration

chinese: 创造低等神龛
english: Create Lesser Shrine

chinese: 产生一道随机元素的龙卷风妨碍敌人，并反复对它们施加伤害，将物理伤害转换为该类元素伤害。龙卷风会追逐敌人一段时间。
english: Create a Tornado of a random element that hinders and repeatedly damages enemies around it, converting physical damage to its element. The Tornado will chase down enemies for a duration.

chinese: 产生一道龙卷风妨碍敌人，并反复对它们施加伤害。它会向前移动一段时间，你可以借此机会朝它发射投射物，使其提升对敌人造成的伤害。随后它会追逐敌人一段时间，把你对它施加的伤害和它本身的伤害一起施加给敌人。
english: Create a Tornado that hinders and repeatedly damages enemies around it. It will move forward for a duration, during which your projectiles can collide with it to deal damage as though it was an enemy. Then it will chase down enemies for a secondary duration, and reflect a portion of the damage it took from your projectiles to them in addition to its own damage.

chinese: 用弓引起闪电爆发，不射出箭矢，但会对前方锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害。
english: Create a burst of lightning from your Bow, firing no arrows but damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.

chinese: 创造一个水球，或移动一个现有的水球并重置它的持续时间。水球持续不断会给它范围内或穿越其范围的生物施加一个短时间存在的浸湿减益效果。你可以用其它技能攻击水球，使其施加冰霜和闪电异常状态。它会固定间隔一段时间发射脉冲。它移动后，会对浸湿的敌人造成广域伤害。
english: Create a sphere of water, or move an existing sphere and reset its duration. The sphere continually applies a drenched debuff with a short duration to enemies in its area or those it moves through. You can hit the sphere with other skills to inflict Cold and Lightning Ailments (other than Chill). The sphere pulses when created, at regular intervals while afflicted by an Ailment, and after moving, damaging all drenched enemies in a large area.

chinese: 产生一面火墙，持续一段时间，对其中的一切造成燃烧伤害。每个进入火墙的敌人在离开时都会获得一个持续很短时间的次级燃烧减益效果。你和友军发射的投射物只要穿过火墙都会附加火焰伤害，并且击中附加次级燃烧减益效果。
english: Create a wall of fire for a duration, which deals burning damage to everything in its area. Each enemy that enters the wall also receives a secondary burning debuff which persists for a short duration after leaving the wall. Any projectiles fired through the wall by you and allies deal added fire damage and apply the wall's secondary debuff on hit.

chinese: 产生 1 个裂缝
english: Creates 1 fissure

chinese: 若近期内换过姿态，则创造 10 个额外的尖刺
english: Creates 10 additional Spikes if you've changed Stance Recently

chinese: 产生 12 个印记
english: Creates 12 markers

chinese: 每个烙印生成 2 只手
english: Creates 2 Hands per Brand

chinese: 生成 2 只额外的手
english: Creates 2 additional Hands

english: Creates 3 Ashen Pillars

english: Creates 4 Ashen Pillars

english: Creates 6 Ashen Pillars

english: Creates 6 Bone Spires

english: Creates 8 Ashen Pillars

english: Creates 9 Spikes

chinese: 创造一个低等神龛, 触摸即可获得加成. 使用后或是放置一段时间后低等神殿即会消失. 技能冷却开始生效.
english: Creates a Lesser Shrine, which will grant a bonus when touched. The Lesser Shrine will disappear after a short duration, or when used. This skill starts on cooldown.

chinese: 在一个区域内创建一片烟雾，处于其中的敌人将被致盲。
english: Creates a Smoke Cloud in an area, which blinds enemies within it.

chinese: 创造一个虚空法球，使它周围的敌人缓速。距离法球越近，该减益效果就越强。法球还会定期辐射范围伤害。虚空法球会消耗其范围内被击败的任何敌人的残骸。同时只能施放一个虚空法球。
english: Creates a Void Sphere which Hinders enemies in an area around it, with the debuff being stronger on enemies closer to the sphere. It also regularly releases pulses of area damage. The Void Sphere will consume the corpses of any enemies which die in its area. Can only have one Void Sphere at a time.

chinese: 在一个位置创造天雷之珠，对周围的每个敌人反复施放闪电并造成伤害。无法被施法回响辅助或被图腾使用。
english: Creates a ball of lightning at a location that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning. Cannot be supported by Spell Echo or used by Totems.

chinese: 制造一个与你使用同样武器的复制体。此技能有短暂冷却时间。
english: Creates a clone of you that attacks with your weapon.

chinese: 创造一个冰晶，在一段时间内脉冲冰霜能量。每次脉冲都会给周围敌人施加一个有单独持续时间的减益效果，降低其生命回复速度，同时给它们施加冰霜曝露。冰晶持续时间结束后会爆炸，对周围敌人造成大量冰霜伤害。
english: Creates a crystal that pulses with cold for a duration. Each pulse applies a debuff to nearby enemies for a secondary duration which reduces life regeneration rate, and also inflicts Cold Exposure. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.

chinese: 创造一个冰晶，持续一段时间。冰晶持续时间结束后会爆炸，对周围敌人造成冰霜伤害。
english: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing cold damage to enemies around it.

chinese: 创造一个冰晶，持续一段时间。冰晶持续时间结束后会爆炸，对周围敌人造成高额冰霜伤害。
english: Creates a crystal which lasts for a duration. When the crystal's duration ends, it explodes, dealing heavy cold damage to enemies around it.

chinese: 创造一个巨大的藤壶，持续朝敌人猛咬，造成副手范围伤害，伤害值受盾牌防御属性加成。攻击速度的增减会影响伤害的发生频率。
english: Creates a giant barnacle that continually snaps at enemies, dealing off-hand area damage augmented by the defences of the shield. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which damage occurs.

chinese: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上，造成持续冰霜伤害，并冰缓敌人。同时附着后会周期性激活，积累层数提升伤害。移除烙印时会附加一个减益效果，在短时间内造成相同的持续伤害，并对范围内的每个敌人施加冰缓。解除烙印时会保留使用次数。
english: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy, dealing cold damage over time and chilling them. It periodically activates while attached, gaining stages that raise the damage. When removed, a short-duration debuff dealing the same damage over time and chill is applied to each nearby enemy. The brand keeps its charges while detached.

chinese: 创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印，它会激活一次并召唤从天而降的流星，随后便会消失。
english: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It activates once, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky, then is destroyed.

chinese: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上。一旦附着就会周期性激活，给附着烙印的敌人附加能量并产生一股脉冲，对附着烙印的敌人和周围其它敌人造成伤害。附着烙印的敌人的每层能量都会提高脉冲的效果范围和伤害，最多 20 层。烙印消失时移除敌人的所有能量。
english: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and causing a pulse that deals damage to the branded enemy and other nearby enemies. The pulse gains area of effect and damage for each energy on the branded enemy, up to 20. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.

chinese: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上。一旦附着就会周期性激活，给附着烙印的敌人和周围未具有能量的敌人附加能量。烙印消失时，对所有具有能量的敌人造成伤害。
english: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy and nearby enemies who do not have energy. When the brand is detached, all enemies with energy are dealt damage.

chinese: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上。一旦附着就会周期性激活，给附着烙印的敌人附加能量。附着烙印的敌人有 20 层能量时，产生一次大爆炸并将烙印移除。烙印消失时移除敌人的所有能量。
english: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, adding energy to the branded enemy. When the branded enemy reaches 20 energy, a large explosion occurs and the brand is removed. All energy is removed from the enemy when the brand is detached.

chinese: 创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印。该烙印附着后会阶段性激活，召唤从天而降的流星。敌人被击败后烙印消失。
english: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, causing a fiery meteor to fall from the sky. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

chinese: 创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印。该烙印附着后会阶段性激活，发射出一道光束，对具有烙印的敌人及其的敌人造成伤害。敌人被击败后烙印消失。
english: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing a beam which deals damage to the branded enemy and those around it. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

chinese: 创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印。该烙印附着后会阶段性激活，发射光束，对周围和围绕他们的敌人造成伤害。敌人被击败后烙印消失。
english: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, firing beams which deal damage to nearby enemies and those around them. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

chinese: 创造一道魔法烙印，附着在周围一个敌人身上。附着后会周期性激活，触发链接的法术。创造一个可以附着于周围某个敌人的魔法烙印。附着烙印的敌人被击败后烙印才会解除。
english: Creates a magical brand which can attach to a nearby enemy. It periodically activates while attached, triggering linked spells. The brand will detach if the enemy dies.

chinese: 在目标地点周围产生数个印记，它们随后爆炸，造成闪电伤害。不能被多重范围施法辅助。
english: Creates a number of markers around the targeted location, which will explode after a duration, dealing lightning damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

chinese: 在目标地点创造一小片真菌地表。
english: Creates a patch of Fungal Ground at the targeted location.

chinese: 在你周围创造一片感电地面。
english: Creates a patch of Shocked Ground in a radius around you.

chinese: 开启一个连接城镇的时空之门.
english: Creates a portal to the current area's town.

chinese: 产生一个静止的电球，用闪电束打击它效果区域内的敌人，随后分裂的闪电束会击中更多敌人。施法速度词缀可以提高其攻击频率。重新施放该法术会取代原有的电球。
english: Creates a stationary electrical orb that strikes enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning that can then split to hit more enemies. Modifiers to cast speed will increase how frequently it does this. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.

chinese: 你击败被感电的敌人时产生一个风暴
english: Creates a storm when you Kill a Shocked Enemy

chinese: 在你身边创造一股急促的寒流，并对敌人造成伤害。此攻击还会在你身边创造一片开散的冰缓地面效果，并持续对周围的敌人造成冰霜伤害。在此区域内被击败的敌人会生成狂怒球。若你在此区域内，则可以自动获得这些狂怒球。
english: Creates a sudden burst of cold around you, damaging enemies. This also creates a chilling area around you which expands and deals cold damage over time to surrounding enemies in addition to chilling them. Enemies that die while in the area grant Frenzy Charges, and you will passively gain Frenzy Charges while there are enemies in the area.

chinese: 在目标区域创造一股急促的寒流，并对敌人造成伤害，同时创造一片开散的冰缓地面效果，并持续对敌人造成冰霜伤害。在此区域内被击败的敌人有几率生成狂怒球。消耗一个狂怒球能重置其技能冷却。
english: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. Also creates an expanding area which is filled with chilled ground, and deals cold damage over time to enemies. Enemies that die while in the area have a chance to grant Frenzy Charges. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

chinese: 在目标区域创造一股急促的寒流，并对敌人造成伤害。消耗一个暴击球能重置其技能冷却。
english: Creates a sudden burst of cold in a targeted area, damaging enemies. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.

chinese: 创造一片虚空风暴，使其中的敌人致盲。进入风暴区域将引发爆炸，造成范围攻击伤害。
english: Creates a voidstorm that blinds enemies within it. Entering the storm will cause it to explode, dealing attack damage in an area.

chinese: 在目标位置产生一个熔火喷泉，它将在一段时间内持续向周围放出投射物。
english: Creates a volcanic geyser at a location, which will repeatedly unleash projectiles sequentially over the surrounding area for a duration.

chinese: 创造一道可被友方和敌人穿过的力场之墙。但能对敌人产生碰撞的友方投射物也会与此墙发生碰撞，并可从墙面连锁至其他目标。单个投射物仅可与一道力场之墙发生碰撞，且最多碰撞一次。
english: Creates a wall of force which allies and enemies can pass through, but allied projectiles which can collide with enemies will also collide with this wall, and can chain from it to other targets. Projectiles can only collide with a single Wall of Force, and no more than once.

chinese: 聚集空气中的水分, 制造一堵能阻挡敌人行动的冰墙. 在冰墙成形位置的敌人将会受到伤害并且被击退.
english: Creates a wall of ice which holds back enemies. Targets under the wall are damaged and pushed back.

chinese: 创造已经抓回的投射物，但先不把它们发射出去，并且都有即时和附加的持续时间。当你使用回旋之刃时，抓回的投射物向外盘旋飞出，并不再返回。限定爪类和匕首。
english: Creates already-caught projectiles without firing them first, both immediately and over a secondary duration. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

chinese: 产生一片奉献地面，为你和友军提供生命再生，并降低你们身上的诅咒效果。
english: Creates an area of Consecrated Ground, providing life regeneration and reducing the effect of curses for you and allies who stand in it.

chinese: 产生一个的电球，放置时、以及你在其范围内释放闪电技能时，它会以闪电光束攻击范围内的敌人。这些闪电光束可分裂，以击中更多敌人。击中敌人时，电球会传送至被击中的随机一个敌人处。再次施放该技能会替换原有的电球。
english: Creates an electrical orb that will strike enemies in its area of effect with beams of lightning when placed, as well as when you use a lightning skill while within its area. These beams of lightning can then split to hit more enemies. When striking enemies, this orb will teleport to a random enemy struck. Casting this skill again will replace the previous orb.

chinese: 创造独立飞行的飞刃或虚空的武器，并持续一段时间。飞刃以你为中心不断飞舞旋转, 将周围的敌人削成肉泥.
english: Creates an independently-moving vortex of ethereal blades which lasts for a duration. The vortex moves toward nearby enemies, repeatedly damaging enemies that it passes through.

chinese: 制造一个向附近敌人移动的法球，在一段时间后或足够接近敌人时爆炸。爆炸造成范围冰霜法术伤害，并在地面留下一个持续额外时间的漩涡，对其中的敌人持续造成冰霜伤害并使其冰缓。
english: Creates an orb which moves towards nearby enemies, exploding after a duration or when it gets close enough. The explosion deals cold spell damage in an area, and leaves behind a Vortex on the ground for a secondary duration which continues to deal cold damage over time and chill enemies caught in it.

chinese: 同时在你所在位置和目标地点产生印记，它们根据施法速度生长，随后爆炸，造成火焰伤害，不能被多重范围施法辅助。
english: Creates markers at your location and a targeted location, which grow over time based on cast speed, then explode, dealing fire damage. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

chinese: 诅咒一名敌人，使其在被击中时产生多个幻灵。幻灵被视作被标记的敌人的盟友，拥有相同的怪物等级，会施放造成物理伤害的投射物法术，并且免疫诅咒和击退。你同时只能施加一个印记。
english: Curses a single enemy, causing them to spawn multiple phantasms when hit. The phantasms will be allies of the marked enemy with the same monster level. They cast a projectile spell which deals physical damage, and are immune to curses and knockback. You can only have one Mark at a time.

chinese: 诅咒单个敌人，使它身上的眩晕持续时间有几率翻倍。攻击该敌人会获得生命和魔力偷取，使它眩晕可以获得怒火，击败它可以获得一个耐力球。你每次只能添加一种印记。
english: Curses a single enemy, giving a chance to double the duration of stuns on them. Attacking the cursed enemy will leech life and mana, stunning them will grant rage, and killing it will grant an endurance charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

chinese: 诅咒单个敌人，击中敌人时产生药剂充能效果，如果击中并点燃敌人，则在其下方产生燃烧地面，如果使敌人中毒，则在其下方产生腐蚀地面。伤害词缀对这些地面效果无效。一次只能有一个“印记”。
english: Curses a single enemy, granting flask charges when you hit them and creating Burning Ground under them if your hit Ignites them, and Caustic Ground if it Poisons them. Damage modifiers do not apply to these ground effects. You can only have one Mark at a time.

chinese: 诅咒单个敌人，增加其被投射物击中后的伤害，并使投射物在击中敌人时裂化，击中周围的其他目标。一次只能有一个“印记”。
english: Curses a single enemy, increasing the damage they take from projectiles, and making projectiles split when hitting them, to hit other targets around them. You can only have one Mark at a time.

chinese: 诅咒单个敌人，降低它的物理伤害减免，并使它受到的任何击中都附加物理伤害。攻击它会获得生命和魔力，击败它会获得一个狂怒球。你每次只能添加一种印记。
english: Curses a single enemy, lowering their physical damage reduction, and adding physical damage to all hits against them. Attacking the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and killing them will grant a frenzy charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

chinese: 诅咒单个敌人，使它更弱暴击。击败它可以获得生命和魔力，以及一个暴击球。你每次只能添加一种印记。
english: Curses a single enemy, making them more vulnerable to Critical Strikes. Killing the cursed enemy will grant life and mana, and a power charge. You can only have one Mark at a time.

chinese: 诅咒一片区域的所有敌人，降低它们的行动速度，并使它们身上的效果消减得更慢。
english: Curses all enemies in an area, lowering their action speed and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

chinese: 诅咒一片区域的所有目标，使它们击中敌人会获得疲惫状态，并使它们在濒血时受到更多伤害。
english: Curses all targets in an area, causing them to be debilitated when they hit enemies and increasing damage they take while on low life.

chinese: 诅咒区域中的所有目标，最初没有效果，但在诅咒的持续时间消减 60% 后使其无法造成伤害。
english: Curses all targets in an area, having no effect at first, but causing them to deal no damage once 60% of the curse's duration has expired.

chinese: 诅咒一片区域的所有目标，降低它们的混沌抗性。
english: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their chaos resistance.

chinese: 诅咒一片区域的所有目标，降低它们的冰霜抗性，并使它们被击中时有几率被冻结。
english: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their cold resistance and giving them a chance to be frozen when hit.

chinese: 诅咒一片区域的所有目标，降低它们的元素抗性。
english: Curses all targets in an area, lowering their elemental resistances.

chinese: 诅咒一片区域的所有目标，降低它们的火焰抗性，并使它们被击中时有几率被点燃。

chinese: 从法杖射出一枚自动索敌的伤害性投射物，对首个击中的敌人施加一个护盾。对该目标的击中伤害将优先由护盾承受。若护盾被完全击破，将发生爆炸造成范围伤害，并向另一个目标发射一枚新的投射物，为其施加新的护盾。若多个投射物因护盾爆炸同时射出，仅首个命中目标的投射物能成功施加护盾。
english: Fire a damaging projectile from your wand which aims itself towards an enemy and applies a shell to the first enemy struck. Damage from hits against that target is taken from the shell first. If fully depleted, the shell will explode, dealing area damage and firing a projectile at another target to apply a new shell to it. If multiple projectiles are fired by an exploding shell, only the first one to hit a target can apply a shell.

chinese: 用法杖发射一枚投射物，会定期或击中敌人时改变飞行方向。每次改变方向都会产生一枚次要投射物，朝原本的方向飞行。
english: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from.

chinese: 用法杖发射一枚投射物，会定期或击中敌人时改变飞行方向。每次改变方向都会产生一枚次要投射物，朝原本的方向飞行。多个投射物可以击中同一个目标。
english: Fire a projectile from your wand that changes direction in a zig-zag pattern at regular intervals or when hitting enemies. Each time it changes direction, a secondary projectile breaks off, flying in the direction it changed away from. Multiple of these projectiles can hit the same target.

chinese: 射出一个寒冰投射物，在命中目标或抵达目标区域时爆炸，造成范围伤害并生成一片冰缓区域，该区域会持续造成冰霜伤害。该区域会快速向附近的敌人蔓延，直到持续时间结束。
english: Fire a single icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep rapidly across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.

chinese: 发射一枚投射物，在撞击或抵达目标地点时分裂，造成范围伤害。分裂的投射物继续飞行，在结束时再次造成范围伤害。此技能的投射物无法归返。需要剑类或斧类发动。
english: Fire a single projectile that splits on impact or at the targeted location, dealing area damage when it splits and again when the split projectiles explode at the end of their flight. Projectiles from this skill cannot return. Requires a Sword or Axe.

chinese: 射出三支转瞬即逝的电光箭矢，在离弦不久后消失。箭矢如果击中目标而停止飞行，则会爆发出闪电，对目标身后锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害
english: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. If the arrows' flight is stopped by colliding with a target, they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone behind the target

chinese: 射出三支转瞬即逝的电光箭矢，在离弦不久后消失。强劲的力量使箭矢爆发出闪电，对前方锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害。
english: Fire a trio of electrical arrows that quickly dissipate, vanishing shortly after being loosed. The arrows are fired with such force that they create a burst of lightning, damaging enemies in a cone in front of you.

chinese: 射出一支箭矢，在飞行轨迹上投下一个孢囊。孢囊会绽放并喷射荆棘之箭，飞行一小段时间后消失。产生额外投射物的词缀只可以影响最初的箭矢数量，每支箭矢都会投下一个孢囊。
english: Fire an arrow that leaves a spore pod in its wake. The spore pod blooms, firing thorn arrows, which travel for a short time before dissipating. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will only apply to the initial arrows, each of which leaves its own spore pod.

chinese: 射出一个寒冰投射物, 在接触到敌人时会爆炸, 对该范围敌人造成伤害，使附近地面结冰并持续造成伤害.该区域会向周围的敌人蔓延，直到持续时间结束。
english: Fire an icy projectile that bursts on impact or when reaching the targeted area, dealing area damage and creating a chilling area that deals cold damage over time. This area will creep across the ground towards nearby enemies until its duration expires.

chinese: 向空中射出火焰箭矢，在目标区域降下箭雨，撞击时造成范围伤害，并且箭矢会残留在地面一段时间。若你靠近残留的箭矢，它将爆炸造成范围伤害，施加持续火焰伤害效果，并连锁引爆范围内其他残留的箭矢。
english: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing area damage on impact and leaving the arrows stuck in the ground for a duration. If you move close to a stuck arrow, it will explode, dealing area damage and applying a fire damage over time debuff, as well as causing other stuck arrows in range to also explode.

chinese: 向天空射出一串箭矢，并洒向目标区域，对击中的敌人造成伤害，并在落地后创造孢囊。每个孢囊会对周围的敌人持续造成混沌伤害，并减低他们的移动速度。短时间后，孢囊会爆炸，造成范围伤害。
english: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and slows their movement speed. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.

chinese: 向天空射出一串箭矢，并洒向目标区域，对击中的敌人造成伤害，并在落地后创造孢囊。每个孢囊会对周围的敌人持续造成混沌伤害并施加死亡凋零，使其受到的混沌伤害提高。短时间后，孢囊会爆炸，造成范围伤害。
english: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod deals chaos damage over time to nearby enemies and withers them, causing them to take increased chaos damage. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.

chinese: 向天空射出一串箭矢，并洒向目标区域，对击中的敌人造成伤害，并在落地后创造孢囊。每个孢囊都会减低周围敌人的移动速度。短时间后，孢囊会爆炸，造成范围伤害。
english: Fire arrows into the air that rain down around the targeted area, dealing damage to enemies they hit and creating spore pods where they land. Each spore pod slows the movement speed of nearby enemies. The pods last for a duration before bursting, dealing area damage.

chinese: 向你周围所有方向发射寒冰投射物。
english: Fire icy projectiles around you in all directions.

chinese: 每 0.1 秒发射一道光束

english: Fires a beam every 0.2 seconds

chinese: 发射一枚燃烧箭矢造成火焰伤害，并有几率点燃敌人。
english: Fires a burning arrow that deals fire damage and has a chance to ignite.

chinese: 发射一连串的虚空飞刀。此技能有短暂冷却时间。
english: Fires a chaining burst of ethereal blades.

chinese: 射出一发充满闪电能量的箭矢，以闪电霹雳对敌人造成伤害，同时也对周围多个敌人造成伤害。
english: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning, which also damages a number of surrounding enemies.

chinese: 射出一发充满闪电能量的箭矢，以闪电霹雳对敌人造成伤害，并附着在最终目标处，使其遭受多次伤害。
english: Fires a charged arrow which damages enemies by causing them to be struck by a bolt of lightning. It sticks into the final target, causing them to be struck and damaged multiple times.

chinese: 向周围射出一圈匕首，对敌人造成物理伤害。
english: Fires a circle of knives outwards around the caster which deal physical damage.

chinese: 射出一支穿透箭矢，在击中目标时将部分物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害，并在目标背后形成两个垂直的锥形范围攻击其它敌人，此时所有物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。
english: Fires a piercing arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in two cones perpendicular to the target.

chinese: 射出一个穿透投射物，击中后产生一个减益效果，造成持续伤害。其中一部分伤害会治疗你。
english: Fires a piercing projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage.

chinese: 射出一支箭矢，在抵达目标地点前一直穿透敌人。然后从抵达地点向所有方向发射投射物，飞行很短时间后消失。
english: Fires a piercing shot that travels until it reaches the targeted location. It will then fire projectiles out in all directions from that point, which will travel for a short time before disappearing.

chinese: 射出一发剧毒箭矢，击中时对一片区域造成混沌伤害。
english: Fires a poisonous arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact.

chinese: 基于你的武器，投出剧毒的投射物，连锁打击敌人。需要匕首或爪类发动。
english: Fires a poisonous projectile based on your weapon that will chain between enemies. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

chinese: 从法杖中射出一个投射物，接触到物体或敌人时在周围一定范围内产生一系列爆破，每次爆破都会对敌人造成伤害。
english: Fires a projectile from a Wand that causes a series of area explosions in a secondary radius around its point of impact, each damaging enemies.

chinese: 射出一个投射物，击中后产生一个减益效果，造成持续伤害。其中一部分伤害会治疗你。该减益效果可由【瘟疫】传染。
english: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You are healed for a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

chinese: 射出一个投射物，击中后产生一个减益效果，造成持续伤害。你会失去相当于减益伤害一定比例的生命和能量护盾。该减益效果可由【瘟疫】传染。
english: Fires a projectile that applies a damage over time debuff when it hits. You lose Life and Energy Shield equal to a portion of the debuff damage. The debuff is spread by Contagion.

chinese: 发射一个投射物，对击中的敌人造成混沌伤害，所造成的伤害会有一部分转化为能量护盾偷取。
english: Fires a projectile that deals chaos damage to enemies it hits and leeches some of that damage as energy shield.

chinese: 发射会在敌人面前转向他们的投射物，击中时造成伤害并穿透敌人，所造成的伤害会有一部分转化为能量护盾偷取。在飞行过程中，投射物会持续对周围一定范围内的敌人施加负面效果，造成短暂但强大的持续混沌伤害。
english: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it, damaging and piercing through those it hits, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectile travels, it repeatedly applies a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it.

chinese: 发射一枚会转向前方敌人的投射物。该投射物不直接击中敌人，但在其飞行过程中，会对其周围范围内的每个敌人施加一个短时物理持续伤害减益，可叠加 3 层。该减益还会提高他们受到的所有来源的持续伤害。
english: Fires a projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it. The projectile does not hit enemies, but as it travels it applies a short physical damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around it, stacking up to 3 times. The debuff also increases the damage over time they take from all sources.

chinese: 发射一个能够穿透敌人的投射物，在目标地点着地后会创造一个骨弓手灵柩。
english: Fires a projectile that will pierce through enemies to impact the ground at the targeted location, creating a Bone Archer corpse where it lands.

chinese: 使用法杖或弓发射一个投射物，造成火焰、冰霜和闪电伤害。若投射物击中敌人，则会在其周围造成伤害。
english: Fires a projectile with a wand or bow that deals fire, cold and lightning damage. If the projectile hits an enemy, it will deal damage in an area around them.

chinese: 发射一个可以抓回的投射物。当你使用回旋之刃时，抓回的投射物向外盘旋飞出，并不再返回。限定爪类和匕首。
english: Fires a returning projectile that can be caught. Caught projectiles spiral outwards when you use Whirling Blades and do not return. Requires a Dagger or Claw.

chinese: 螺旋发射一串会在敌人面前转向他们的投射物，击中时造成伤害并穿透敌人，所造成的伤害会有一部分转化为能量护盾偷取。在飞行过程中，投射物会持续对周围一定范围内的敌人施加负面效果，造成短暂但强大的持续混沌伤害。
english: Fires a series of projectiles in a spiral that turn towards enemies in front of them, damaging and piercing through those they hit, and leeching some of that damage as energy shield. As the projectiles travel, they repeatedly apply a short but powerful chaos damage over time debuff to each enemy in an area around them.

chinese: 向空中射出单发箭矢，并在目标地点落下。箭矢在落下的位置造成范围伤害，同时释放火焰波浪，对敌人施加燃烧减益效果。箭矢落点范围也会施加减益效果。
english: Fires a single arrow up in the air, to rain down at a targeted location. The arrow deals area damage around where it lands, as well as releasing a wave of fire which will apply a burning debuff to enemies. The impact of the arrow will also inflict this debuff.

chinese: 发射一枚无法造成伤害的眼球形投射物。眼球撞击地面或自然消散时，发射一圈快速的霰弹，霰弹对击中的敌人造成冰霜伤害。
english: Fires a single eye projectile which cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a fast spiral of shards. The shards will deal cold damage to enemies they impact.

chinese: 发射一枚眼球形投射物，不断螺旋发射霰弹投射物。霰弹撞击敌人会造成冰霜伤害。眼球本身并不能伤害敌人。眼球撞击地面或自然消散时，会额外发射一圈更快速的霰弹。
english: Fires a single eye projectile which constantly releases shard projectiles in a spiral. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies. When the eye dissipates or collides with terrain, it releases a faster spiral of extra shards.

chinese: 发射一枚眼球形投射物，螺旋发射出霰弹投射物并逐渐消散。霰弹对击中的敌人造成冰霜伤害。眼球无法对敌人造成伤害。
english: Fires a single eye projectile which releases a number shard projectiles in a spiral before dissipating. The shards will damage enemies they impact, dealing cold damage. The eye cannot damage enemies.

chinese: 向空中射出单发母箭，抵达目标地点后向所有方向发射箭矢。
english: Fires a single payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. It will then fire arrows out in all directions from that point.

chinese: 射出一个螺旋移动的天雷之珠，对周围的每个敌人反复施放闪电并造成伤害。
english: Fires a single projectile which moves in a spiral while damaging each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

chinese: 射出一个移动缓慢的天雷之珠，对周围的每个敌人反复施放闪电并造成伤害。
english: Fires a slow-moving projectile that damages each enemy in an area around it repeatedly with bolts of lightning.

chinese: 发射出一个缓慢移动并可以穿透敌人的投射物, 造成冰霜伤害.
english: Fires a slow-moving projectile that pierces through enemies, dealing cold damage.

chinese: 发射一支缓慢移动的蛇形箭，在刺穿敌人的同时造成混沌伤害，并在地面留下一道腐蚀之痕。站在腐蚀地面上的敌人会持续受到混沌伤害。
english: Fires a slow-moving serpentine arrow which deals chaos damage while piercing enemies, and leaves a trail of caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.

chinese: 传爆序列中之前每 2 个地雷发射一个额外投射物
english: Fires an additional Projectile for every 2 prior Mines in Detonation Sequence

chinese: 每 3 个按传爆序列引爆的地雷就发射一枚额外投射物
english: Fires an additional Projectile for every 3 prior Mines in Detonation Sequence

chinese:
在前方依弧形掷下数支匕首，对敌人造成物理伤害。
无法被齐射辅助。
english:
Fires an arc of knives down into the ground in front of the caster which deal physical damage.
Cannot be supported by Volley.

chinese: 向前方依弧形射出数支匕首，对敌人造成物理伤害。
english: Fires an arc of knives outwards in front of the caster which deal physical damage.

chinese: 对目标地点射出一支箭，当箭到达时在目标地创造一个你的复制体。这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋，会向空中射击并在一个目标周围倾泻箭矢。
english: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.

chinese: 对目标地点射出一支箭，当箭到达时在目标地创造一个你的复制体。这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋，并射出随机元素之箭，将造成的所有物理伤害转化为选中的元素伤害，并且不造成其他类型的伤害。
english: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.

chinese: 对目标地点射出一支箭, 当箭到达时在目标地创造一个你的复制体. 这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋.
english: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, a clone is summoned. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.

chinese: 对目标地点射出一支箭，当箭到达时将你传送至目标地，并在原地留下一个你的复制体。这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋，会向空中射击并在一个目标周围倾泻箭矢。
english: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire arrows into the air to land around a target.

chinese: 对目标地点射出一支箭，当箭到达时将你传送至目标地，并在原地留下一个你的复制体。这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋，并射出随机元素之箭，将造成的所有物理伤害转化为选中的元素伤害，并且不造成其他类型的伤害。
english: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver to fire random elemental arrows which convert all physical damage to the chosen element and deal no damage of other damage types.

chinese: 对目标地点射出一支箭, 当箭到达时将你传送至目标地, 并在原地留下一个你的复制体. 这个复制体使用跟你一样的弓与箭袋.
english: Fires an arrow at the target destination. When the arrow lands, you are teleported to it and a clone is summoned at your old location. The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver.

chinese: 朝天射出一支箭矢落在目标地点，造成区域伤害。箭矢会刺入大地，定期朝周围的其它箭矢发射一道闪电束，在彼此之间造成区域伤害。
english: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to another arrow near it, dealing area damage between them.

chinese: 朝天射出一支箭矢落在目标地点，造成区域伤害。箭矢会刺入大地，定期朝你发射一道闪电束，在箭矢和你之间造成区域伤害。
english: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location, dealing area damage. The arrow sticks in the ground where it lands, and periodically fires a beam of lightning to you, dealing area damage between the arrow and you.

chinese: 向天空射箭在指定的地点落下。造成范围伤害，并且形成雷霆风暴，使敌人致盲。进入雷霆风暴范围时开始充能，离开时便会消散。当雷霆风暴等级达到最大值时，离开时会剧烈爆炸，造成范围伤害，并触发雷霆爆裂技能。这个技能必须由你手动施放，不能通过图腾、陷阱、地雷或其他物品来使用。
english: Fires an arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. On impact, deals area damage and creates a thunderstorm which blinds enemies within it. Entering the thunderstorm will cause it to gain stages, and leaving it will cause it to dissipate. Leaving the storm while it is at maximum stages will cause it to explode, dealing damage and triggering Thunderburst. You must use this skill yourself, it cannot be used by Totems, Traps, Mines, or other objects that use skills for you.

chinese: 射出一支箭矢，在击中目标时将部分物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害，并在目标背后形成锥形范围攻击其它敌人，此时所有物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。
english: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target.

chinese: 发射一支箭矢，将目标身上的部分物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害，并将目标身后锥形区域内的所有物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。当你使用这个技能时，它会召唤一支持续一段时间幻影游侠小队。无法用于图腾、陷阱或地雷。
english: Fires an arrow that converts some physical damage to cold on its target and converts all physical damage to cold in a cone behind that target. When you use this skill, it summons a squad of Mirage Sharpshooters for a duration. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 射出一发带有火焰能量的箭矢, 接触到敌人时会爆炸, 并对其与周围的敌人造成额外火焰伤害, 同时有较高的几率造成点燃.
english: Fires an arrow that explodes, dealing fire damage to its target and other nearby enemies, with an increased chance of igniting them.

chinese: 射出一支箭矢，在击中最后的目标后留在地面，将其拘束在其中。被诱捕的敌人尝试挣脱时移动速度降低。一旦被捕猎的敌人离开效果区域，该圈套就被破坏。
english: Fires an arrow that remains in the ground behind its final target, tethering that enemy to it. Ensnared enemies have less movement speed while trying to break the snare. The snare will break if they leave the area of effect.

chinese: 射出一支箭矢，分裂并击中多个目标。
english: Fires an arrow that splits to hit different targets.

chinese: 射出一发带有腐蚀效果的箭矢, 对击中的敌人造成额外混沌伤害, 并且产生腐蚀地面。站在地面上的敌人将会持续的受到混沌伤害.
english: Fires an arrow which deals chaos damage in an area on impact, and spreads caustic ground. Enemies standing on the caustic ground take chaos damage over time.

chinese: 射出一根箭矢并减速飞向目标。箭矢会在飞出后变得不稳定最后爆炸并在范围内造成武器伤害，将一般的物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。
english: Fires an arrow which decelerates to the target location, the arrow will then become unstable and explode dealing weapon damage in an area, converting half of the physical damage to cold damage.

chinese: 发射一支箭矢，射在一名敌人身上或墙上，持续一段时间后或目标身上的箭矢达到上限后会引发爆炸，对周围造成范围伤害。如果一个敌人身上有多个爆炸箭矢，则第一个箭矢爆炸时会引爆剩余箭矢，它们的伤害会计入爆炸总伤害。
english: Fires an arrow which will stick into an enemy or wall, and then explode, dealing area damage around it, either after a duration or when the maximum number of arrows stuck to that target is reached. If an enemy has multiple Explosive Arrows stuck in them, the first one to explode will consume the others, adding their damage to its explosion.

chinese: 向天空射出箭矢，在一个区域降下箭雨。每一支箭矢落地时都造成范围伤害，并可以在目标地点叠加。
english: Fires arrows up in the air, to rain down in an area. Each arrow deals area damage around where it lands, and they will all overlap on the targeted location.

chinese: 射出带电的箭矢，箭矢会重复飞行一小段时间再改变方向。当箭矢击中敌人时，会生产一道闪电击中敌人，并伤害周围的多个敌人。
english: Fires charged arrows, which repeatedly travel for a short time before changing direction. When they hit enemies, they are struck by a bolt of lightning which damages a number of surrounding enemies.

chinese: 向 10 个周围的敌人额外发射投射物
english: Fires extra Projectiles at up to 10 surrounding Enemies

chinese: 向 6 个周围的敌人额外发射投射物
english: Fires extra Projectiles at up to 6 surrounding Enemies

chinese: 向 7 个周围的敌人额外发射投射物

chinese: 向 8 个周围的敌人额外发射投射物

chinese: 对不同的目标射出多重箭矢.
english: Fires multiple arrows at different targets.

chinese: 向空中射出多支箭矢，飞行一段时间后陆续抵达，先发射至一个指定位置，抵达后向四面八方展开。每支箭矢会对其周围区域造成伤害。若范围内有目标，则一半数量的箭矢会直接飞向目标。
english: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in multiple sequences after a delay, each starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

chinese: 向空中射出多支箭矢，飞行一段时间后陆续抵达，先发射至一个指定位置，抵达后向四面八方展开。每支箭矢会对其周围区域造成伤害。若范围内有目标，则一半数量的箭矢会直接飞向目标。
english: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

chinese: 向空中射出多支箭矢，飞行一段时间后陆续抵达，从你面前开始朝目标方向蔓延。每支箭矢会对其周围区域造成伤害。
english: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to land in sequence after a delay, starting in front of you and proceeding in a line in the direction of the target. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it.

chinese: 向空中射出多支箭矢，飞行一段时间后陆续缓慢抵达，从目标位置向四面八方蔓延。每支箭矢会对其周围区域造成伤害。若范围内有目标，则一半数量的箭矢会直接飞向目标。
english: Fires multiple arrows into the air, to slowly land in sequence after a delay, starting at the targeted location and spreading outwards in all directions. Each arrow deals damage in an area around it. Half of the arrows will land directly on targets if there are targets in their range.

chinese: 每 1.2 秒发射一波投射物
english: Fires projectiles every 1.2 seconds

chinese: 从目标地点发射随机移动的投射物，穿透敌人并对其造成伤害。持续一段时间后，投射物会爆炸，造成范围伤害。
english: Fires projectiles from the targeted location that move randomly and damage enemies they pierce through. They explode after a duration, dealing area damage.

chinese: 向所有方向发射投射物，将它们的所有物理伤害转化成随机元素伤害，并获得一个增益效果，使你在一段时间内不受诅咒影响。同时使用时移除你身上的诅咒。
english: Fires projectiles in all directions, converting all their physical damage to a random element, and grants a buff which makes you unaffected by curses for a duration. Removes curses on you when used.

chinese: 发射随机移动的投射物，对穿透的敌人造成伤害。投射物在短暂飞行后爆炸，造成范围伤害。
english: Fires projectiles that move randomly and damage enemies they pierce through. They explode after a duration, dealing area damage.

chinese: 发射弧线飞行的投射物，撞击敌人或目标地面时造成范围伤害。瞄准更远的目标会使投射物扩散，落在更宽阔的区域。
english: Fires projectiles which fly in an arc, dealing area damage on impact with either enemies or the ground near where you target. Targeting farther away causes the projectiles to spread out and land over a wider area.

english: Fires tendrils at up to 1 Target

english: Fires up to 5 Arrows at different targets

chinese: 挥动你的法杖同时攻击附近的所有敌人. 濒死的敌人将会被终结, 并产生同等数量的暴击球. 无法被齐射辅助。
english: Fires your wand simultaneously at all nearby enemies, culling those close to death and granting you a power charge for each. Cannot be supported by Volley.

chinese: 挥动你的法杖，向周围一定数量的敌人各发射一个投射物。若敌人在被击中的短时间内被击败，则产生一个暴击球。
english: Fires your wand to fire a single projectile each at a number of nearby enemies, granting you a power charge if an enemy is killed by, or soon after, the hit.

chinese: 使敌人中毒时获得毒力
english: Grants Virulence when you Poison an Enemy

chinese: 获得一个增益效果，给法术和攻击增添冰霜伤害。如敌人被你粉碎，则该技能将其引爆，对周围的敌人造成范围冰霜伤害。该伤害不套用调整法术伤害的词缀。
english: Grants a buff adding cold damage to spells and attacks. If you shatter an enemy, this skill will cause them to explode and deal AoE cold damage to enemies near them. This damage is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

chinese: 给予一个增益效果，使中毒伤害提高，并有几率造成中毒。当你带有此增益时使敌人中毒，你会获得【毒力】，并且召唤一个会投掷投射物和范围攻击的【苦痛爬行者】。你会持续失去【毒力】，【毒力】越高，失去的速度越快。【毒力】消退后【苦痛爬行者】就会死亡。
english: Grants a buff giving more poison damage and a chance to inflict poison. When you poison an enemy while you have this buff, you gain Virulence, and summon an Agony Crawler minion that uses projectile and area attacks. You will lose Virulence over time, at a rate which increases the more Virulence you have. The minion will die when you have no Virulence.

chinese: 于手中凝聚火焰之力, 为物理伤害额外增加火焰伤害. 若是你击败了一个敌人, 溢出的伤害将会以点燃的形式扩散至附近的敌人.该技能引起的燃烧只会受到持续伤害词缀的影响(燃烧属于持续伤害)
english: Grants a buff providing fire damage based on your physical damage. While you have this buff, if you kill an enemy, other enemies near them will be burned based on the overkill damage. The burn inflicted by this skill can only be affected by modifiers to damage over time (burning damage is damage over time).

chinese: 获得一个增益效果，给法术和攻击增添闪电伤害。如被击败的是感电的敌人，则该技能会创造一个风暴，在一段时间内用闪电打击你周围的敌人。该技能施加的伤害不套用调整法术伤害的词缀。
english: Grants a buff which adds lightning damage to spells and attacks. If you kill a shocked enemy, this skill will create a storm, causing lightning bolts to strike enemies around you for a duration. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

chinese: 获得一个增益效果，身上每有一个生效的捷技能，就会造成更多伤害。当你拥有这个增益时，该技能会将周围的空间会化为一道现实裂口，释放脉冲伤害你周围的所有敌人。你对敌人施加异常状态时，会为你堆叠【异界威压】，从而提高裂口内脉冲的频率。异界威压会随时间逐渐流失，并且威压越强，流失的速度就越快。该技能施加的伤害无法被法术伤害词缀加成。
english: Grants a buff which causes you to deal more damage for each Herald skill affecting you. While you have this buff, this skill turns the space around you into a tear in reality, releasing pulses that damage enemies around you. Inflicting Ailments causes you to gain Otherworldly Pressure, which increases the frequency of the pulses. You will lose Otherworldly Pressure over time, at a rate which increases the more of it you have. The damage inflicted by this skill is not affected by modifiers to spell damage.

chinese: 获得一个增益效果，使你造成更多物理伤害。在该效果下击败敌人后，该技能会召唤一个【纯净哨兵】，如【纯净哨兵】已经达到上限，则刷新其中一个的持续时间和生命值。【纯净哨兵】会使用单人近战攻击和范围近战攻击。
english: Grants a buff which lets you deal more physical damage. When you kill an enemy while you have this buff, this skill will summon a Sentinel of Purity, or refresh the duration and life of an existing one instead if you have the maximum number of them. The Sentinels of Purity have a single-target melee attack and an area melee attack.

chinese: 获得一个增益效果，它会大幅降低你的能量护盾，用于将你装备的剑变为一把能量之刃。再次施放该法术会移除此增益。需要剑类武器发动。该技能无法被触发。
english: Grants a buff which significantly lowers your maximum Energy Shield to transform your equipped swords into swords formed from that energy. Casting the spell again removes the buff. This skill cannot be triggered or used with non-sword weapons.

chinese: 击中敌人，将部分物理伤害转化为混沌伤害，并使敌人中毒。该技能受技能持续时间词缀影响。双持武器时会使用两把武器同时攻击并造成伤害。限定爪类、匕首与剑类。
english: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, deals the damage of both weapons in one strike. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.

chinese: 击中敌人，将部分部分物理伤害转化为混沌伤害，并使敌人中毒。该技能受技能持续时间词缀影响。双持武器时会用两把武器同时攻击。限定爪类、匕首与剑类。
english: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to chaos damage and inflicting poison which will be affected by modifiers to skill duration. If dual wielding, will strike with both weapons. Requires a claw, dagger or sword.

chinese: 凝聚冰霜之力，转换一部分的物理伤害为冰霜伤害以重击敌人。若受到攻击的非传奇敌人被冻结且生命少于 1/3，则被冰霜之锤命中时会碎成冰屑。如连续攻击三次，则第三次冻结敌人的几率更高。限定锤类、短杖或长杖。
english: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If a non-unique enemy is frozen and is on less than one third life, they will shatter when hit by Glacial Hammer. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will freeze enemies more easily. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

chinese: 凝聚冰霜之力，转换一部分的物理伤害为冰霜伤害以重击敌人。如连续攻击三次，则第三次必定爆击。限定锤类、短杖或长杖。
english: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. If striking three times in a row, the third strike will be a critical strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

chinese: 凝聚冰霜之力，转换一部分的物理伤害为冰霜伤害以重击敌人，同时在敌人周围造成一个让敌人无法逃脱的冰墙。限定锤类、短杖或长杖。
english: Hits enemies, converting some of your physical damage to cold damage. It traps enemies with you in a circle of ice so that they can't escape. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

chinese: 为你的武器注入神圣能量并挥击。成功击中敌人将召唤出一把主手武器的复制品，作为神圣武装。这些神圣武装是无法被伤害的召唤物，会攻击你使用神圣打击技能所瞄准的敌人。需要装备锤、短杖或长杖。
english: Infuse your weapon with holy energy and swing. Successfully hitting an enemy will summon forth a copy of your Main Hand weapon as a Holy Armament. These Holy Armaments are undamageable minions, and will attack the enemies you target with Holy Strike. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

chinese: 灌能吟唱(辅)
english: Infused Channelling

chinese: 凝聚闪电之力, 转换一部分的物理伤害为闪电伤害以重击目标. 闪电之力在击中敌人后会在其身旁形成电球，若未击中敌人则在地面生成电球。电球会持续向其他周围的敌人发射投射物，也会对附加电球的敌人造成伤害。
english: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy becomes an orb attached to the enemy you hit, or the ground if you don't hit an enemy. The orb will periodically fire projectiles at other nearby enemies for a duration, which will also damage the enemy the orb is attached to.

chinese: 凝聚闪电之力，将近战武器的部分物理伤害转化为闪电伤害重击敌人。充盈的闪电之力在击中后会穿透并分裂成一道投射物，袭击更远处的敌人并连锁弹射。若该近战攻击没有失手，则后续的闪电投射物无法被躲避。
english: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as a projectile as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies and chain between them. The projectile cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.

chinese: 凝聚闪电之力，将近战武器的部分物理伤害转化为闪电伤害重击敌人。充盈的闪电之力在击中后会穿透并分裂成数道投射物，袭击更远处的敌人。若该近战攻击没有失手，则后续的闪电投射物无法被躲避。
english: Infuses your melee weapon with electrical energies as you swing. In addition to converting some of your physical damage to lightning damage, the stored energy is released from the weapon as projectiles as you strike, flying out to hit farther-away enemies. The projectiles cannot miss if the melee attack hit a target.

chinese: 给武器灌注熔岩之力，对敌人造成物理及火焰伤害。此攻击会向前发射熔岩火球，着地时对敌人造成范围伤害。
english: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth causing area attack damage to enemies where they land.

chinese: 给武器灌注熔岩之力，对敌人造成物理及火焰伤害，并从击中的敌人身上发射出熔岩球，射向该攻击击中的所有敌人。这些熔岩球着地时对敌人造成范围伤害。
english: Infuses your melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land.

chinese: 为你的长杖灌注奥术能量，降低魔力消耗并提高格挡几率。当你格挡时，释放一道奥术脉冲，在一段时间内对环形范围内的敌人造成伤害。
english: Infuses your staff with arcane energy, lowering your mana costs and increasing your chance to block. When you block, you release an arcane wave, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration.

chinese: 给双手武器灌注熔岩之力，对敌人造成物理及火焰伤害，并从击中的敌人身上发射出熔岩球，射向该攻击击中的所有敌人。这些熔岩球着地时对敌人造成范围伤害。该技能的每第五次攻击会射出更多高伤害投射物。
english: Infuses your two-handed melee weapon with molten energies to attack with physical and fire damage. This attack causes balls of molten magma to launch forth from the enemies you hit, divided amongst all enemies hit by the strike. These will deal area attack damage to enemies where they land. Every fifth time you attack with this skill it fires more, high-damage projectiles.

chinese: 对目标造成物理及火焰伤害, 并在挥击的途中从武器弹射出熔岩球. 这些熔岩球在着地时会爆炸, 并对附近的敌人造成伤害.
english: Launch molten projectiles from the point of impact, causing AoE attack damage to enemies where they land.

chinese: 向空中发射一束燃烧的投射物，落地时击中目标并造成范围伤害。
english: Launches a fiery projectile high into the air, to drop on a target and deal area damage where it lands.

chinese: 以施法者为中心，螺旋发射一连串火球。
english: Launches a series of fireballs in a spiral around the caster.

chinese: 射出击中地形或敌人时分裂的寒冰碎片。分裂后投射物变为第二形态，加快飞行速度并能穿透敌人。
english: Launches a shard of ice that splits on hitting terrain or enemies. After splitting, the projectiles are in second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

chinese: 发射一枚螺旋前进的刀刃，对敌人造成武器伤害。它还会以环形方式发射多个投射物。
english: Launches a spinning blade that deals weapon damage to enemies. If firing multiple projectiles, they will be fired in a circle.

chinese: 发出一道无法预测的旋风，它会随机移动一段时间，并反复对接触的敌人造成伤害。
english: Launches an unpredictable, piercing twister projectile that moves randomly for a duration, repeatedly dealing damage to enemies it intersects.

chinese: 凝聚冰之碎片为矛并向前射出, 此冰矛将会穿透附近的敌人, 并对一定距离以外的敌人具有较高的暴击率.
english: Launches shards of ice in rapid succession. After travelling a short distance they change to a second form, which moves much faster and pierces through enemies.

chinese: 朝四面八方施放出多颗变幻莫测的电球，这些电球将会随机移动，直到撞到敌人或自然消失。
english: Launches unpredictable sparks in all directions that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.

chinese: 施放出多颗变幻莫测的电球，这些电球将会随机移动直到撞到敌人或是自然消失.

chinese: 施放出多颗变幻莫测的电球，这些电球将会随机移动，移动速度和距离各有不同，直到撞到敌人或是自然消失。
english: Launches unpredictable sparks with that move randomly with large differences in speed and distance until they hit an enemy or expire.
