chinese:
生命偷取效果在满血时不会被移除
生命偷取效果改为给羁绊对象恢复生命
羁绊对象从偷取中得到的每秒生命总恢复量上限与你相同
english:
Life Leech effects are not removed at Full Life
Life Leech effects apply Recovery Linked Target instead of you
Linked target's Maximum total Life Recovery per second from Leech is equal to yours

chinese:
只有药剂才能把生命回至低血以上
受到击中伤害时，抵御下半生命池 40% 的生命损失
被抵御的生命损失有 100% 在 4 秒内丧失
english:
Life Recovery other than Flasks cannot Recover Life to above Low Life
When taking Damage from Hits, 40% of Life loss below half Life is Prevented, then 100% of Life loss prevented this way is lost over 4 seconds

chinese: 必须同时辅助一个持续吟唱技能和一个非吟唱法术技能。吟唱技能在吟唱过程中每隔一段时间会触发一个法术技能。无法辅助图腾、陷阱或地雷施放的技能。瓦尔技能和有保留效果的技能无法被触发。
english: Must support both a channelling skill and a non-channelling spell skill to work. The channelling skill will trigger a spell periodically while channelling. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

chinese: 必须同时辅助一个攻击技能和一个法术技能。法术技能会在攻击技能击败敌人时触发。无法辅助图腾、陷阱或地雷。瓦尔技能、持续吟唱类技能和有保留效果的技能无法被触发。
english: Must support both a melee attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it kills an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

chinese:
必须同时辅助一个能够产生可受到伤害的召唤生物技能，以及
一个能够产生永久光环的光环技能。
无法辅助触发技能、旗帜技能或姿态技能。
english:
Must support both a skill that creates minions which can be damaged, and
 an aura skill that creates permanent auras around you.
Cannot support triggered skills, banner skills or stance skills.

chinese: 必须同时辅助一个击中敌人的技能和一个魔蛊诅咒。该魔蛊会在敌人被另一技能击中时施加给它们。无法辅助图腾、陷阱和地雷。召唤生物不能通过这种方式施加魔蛊。
english: Must support both a skill that hits enemies, and a hex curse skill to work. The hex will be applied when enemies are hit by the other skill. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Minions cannot apply hexes this way.

chinese: 必须同时辅助一个攻击技能和一个法术技能。法术技能会在攻击技能对敌人造成暴击时触发。无法辅助图腾、陷阱或地雷。瓦尔技能、持续吟唱类技能和有保留效果的技能无法被触发。
english: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

chinese: 激活后持续消耗魔力，在你周围召唤出从天空降下的虚空武器，对命中的敌人造成伤害。每把刀刃会尽量攻击箭雨区域内的不同敌人。每个敌人每次箭雨攻击只会被命中一次，无论多少武器落在附近。该技能无法被触发，也不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用。
english: Once activated, continuously spends mana to cause volleys of ethereal weapons rain from the sky around you, dealing damage to enemies they impact. Each Blade will target a separate enemy in the volley area if possible. Each enemy can only be hit once by each volley, even if multiple blades land near them. This skill cannot be triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 每秒一次，将附近的一具灵柩复活为一名蹒跚的不死生物。该召唤生物会跟随你并以近战打击攻击你的敌人，但会很快崩解。当这些召唤生物处于低生命时，攻击速度显著提高。
english: Once per second, raise a nearby corpse as a shambling undead. This minion will follow you and attack your enemies with melee strikes, but quickly falls apart. These minions have significantly increased attack speed while on low life.

chinese: 发动一次旋转攻击，对你周围的敌人反复造成伤害，并根据你的姿态创造剑刃风暴，根据你的武器伤害和攻击速度对敌人造成伤害，并持续一段时间。血姿态下的剑刃风暴静止不动，并造成流血状态。沙姿态下的剑刃风暴会缓慢向前移动，并致盲敌人。需要剑类和斧类。默认为血姿态。
english: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a bladestorm matching your stance. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

chinese: 发动一次旋转攻击，对你周围的敌人造成伤害，并随机产生一种剑刃风暴，根据你的武器伤害和攻击速度对敌人反复造成伤害，并持续一段时间。血之剑刃风暴静止不动，并造成流血状态。沙之剑刃风暴会缓慢向前移动，并将敌人致盲。需要剑类和斧类。
english: Perform a spinning attack, damaging enemies around you and creating a random bladestorm. The bladestorm repeatedly damages enemies, based on your weapon damage and attack time, for a duration. Blood bladestorms are stationary and cause Bleeding, while Sand bladestorms move slowly forwards and Blind enemies. Requires a Sword or Axe.

chinese: 使用近战武器进行一次打击，若是命中敌人则累积一颗狂怒球。带着狂怒球的状态下将会增加你的攻击速度。
english: Perform a strike with a melee weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.

chinese: 发动一次近战攻击，用闪电攻击周围的一个敌人，造成范围伤害。每个目标只能被该技能击中一次。击中敌人时使你获得光环并持续一段时间。限定剑类、斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖或空手。
english: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike a nearby enemy, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Hitting an enemy grants an aura for a duration. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 发动一次近战攻击，用闪电攻击周围的敌人，造成范围伤害。每个目标只能被该技能击中一次。限定剑类、斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖或空手。
english: Performs a melee attack, and causes lightning to strike nearby enemies, dealing damage in an area. Each target can only be hit once by this skill. Requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 朝目标方向发起一连串快速传送，与怪物或地形重叠时停止。如果使用“原地攻击”，会朝反方向传送。和其它闪现技能共用冷却时间。无法被辅助。
english: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location, stopping if you would overlap with monsters or terrain. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. Cannot be supported.

chinese: 朝目标方向发起一连串快速传送。如果使用“原地攻击”，会朝反方向传送。和其它闪现技能共用冷却时间。
english: Performs a series of quick teleports towards a targeted location. If using the "Attack in Place" option, the direction is reversed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

chinese: 发出一声战吼，嘲讽全部周围的敌人，吸引他们攻击，增助随后的打击攻击。使自身和友军获得一个增益，提高元素抗性。
english: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent strike attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that  grants elemental resistances.

chinese: 发出一声战吼，嘲讽周围的敌人，吸引他们攻击，并使自身和周围的友军获得增益。自身和友军还会获得耐力球。
english: Performs a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user and granting a buff to the user and nearby allies. The user and allied players also gain endurance charges.

chinese: 发出一声战吼，嘲讽周围的敌人，吸引他们攻击，并增助随后的攻击。同时基于你的武器伤害给队友施加一个增益效果。
english: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. Nearby allies gain a buff based on the damage of your weapon.

chinese: 发出一声战吼，嘲讽周围的敌人，吸引他们攻击，增助随后的攻击。使自身和友军获得一个增益，提高暴击几率。
english: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that boosts critical strike chance.

chinese: 发出一声战吼，嘲讽周围的敌人，吸引他们攻击，并增助随后的攻击。使自身和友军获得一个增益，获得相当于部分物理伤害的额外火焰伤害。除了嘲讽，敌人还会受到次级减益效果，使其在被击败时爆炸，造成范围火焰伤害。
english: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants a portion of their physical damage as extra fire damage. In addition to being taunted, enemies are inflicted with a secondary debuff causing them to explode when they die, dealing fire damage in an area.

chinese: 发出一声战吼，嘲讽周围的敌人，吸引他们攻击，增助随后的攻击。使自身和友军获得一个增益，提高移动速度。
english: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that grants movement speed.

chinese: 发出一声战吼，嘲讽周围的敌人，吸引他们攻击，并增助随后的攻击。使自身和友军获得一个增益，提高护甲和晕眩阈值。
english: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user and exerting subsequent slam attacks. The user and nearby allies gain a buff that increases their armour and stun threshold.

chinese: 发出一声战吼，嘲讽周围的敌人，吸引它们的攻击，同时利用周围的灵柩召唤蜃影武士。每个蜃影武士都会在消散前使用链接的攻击技能。
english: Performs a warcry, taunting nearby enemies to attack the user, and summoning Mirage Warriors from nearby corpses. The Mirage Warriors each use a linked attack skill once before dissipating.

chinese: 使用远程武器进行一次攻击，若是命中敌人则累积一颗狂怒球。带着狂怒球的状态下将会增加你的攻击速度。
english: Performs an attack with a ranged weapon that gives the character a frenzy charge if it hits. Frenzy charges increase your attack speed.

chinese: 使用近战武器发动两次快速打击，每次都会召唤出你的影分身持续一段时间，并用相同的方式连续攻击敌人。
english: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, each of which summons a double of you for a duration to continuously attack monsters in this fashion.

chinese: 使用近战武器发动两次快速打击，积累层数并加快该技能的攻击速度。移动时失去所有层数。
english: Performs two fast strikes with a melee weapon, gaining stages which cause this skill to attack faster. All stages are lost when you move.

chinese: 使用近战武器发动两次快速打击。

chinese: 对你在目标区域中的可受到伤害的召唤生物施加永久性折磨，使其受到越来越高的物理伤害。每个受到该效果影响的召唤生物使你获得生命再生，效果根据折磨减益的当前伤害决定。受折磨的召唤生物的生命值低于五分之一时会爆炸。
english: Permanently Afflicts any of your damageable minions in a targeted area, causing them to take physical damage over time, at an accelerating rate. Each such minion causes you to regenerate life at a rate based on the current damage of it's Affliction debuff. Afflicted Minions explode if their life is lowered to a fifth of maximum.

chinese: 从一个灵柩中复苏一只魔卫，它会跟随你并攻击敌人。魔卫会近战打击，也会使用一种无法闪避的范围猛击。

chinese: 从一个灵柩中复苏一只魔卫，它会跟随你并攻击敌人。魔卫会近战打击。
english: Raises a zombie minion from a corpse, which will follow you and attack enemies with a melee strike.

chinese: 将亡灵魔法射向目标位置的上空，汇聚成一只魔卫。该魔卫会坠击地面，造成范围冲击伤害。该魔卫无法在坠击中幸存。
english: Raises necromantic energies into the sky above a targeted location, where they coalesce into a zombie minion. The minion then attacks by falling to the ground, causing an impact that deals damage in an area. The zombie cannot survive the impact.

chinese: 回春图腾
english: Rejuvenation Totem

chinese: 发射波束，对你前方长形范围内的敌人造成闪电伤害，并呈一定角度分裂出一些小型波束，击中两侧其它敌人。
english: Release a beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you, and has several smaller beams branch off from it at an angle, hitting more enemies to the sides.

chinese: 发射汇聚波束，对你前方长形范围内的敌人造成闪电伤害。
english: Release a concentrated beam which deals lightning damage to enemies in a long area in front of you.

chinese: 复制并释放出一个你所使用的武器或其投射物, 并带有闪电在一个定点旋转, 对区域中的敌人造成伤害. 有 10 秒冷却时间.
english: Release a lightning charged spinning copy of your weapon or its projectiles that rotates around a point, damaging enemies in an area.

chinese: 对你面前的敌人们造成普通攻击的伤害. 此技能有短暂冷却时间.
english: Release an arc of force from your weapon or fists, damaging enemies in front of you.

chinese: 释放 3 股震荡波
english: Releases 3 waves

chinese: 释放 4 股震荡波
english: Releases 4 waves

chinese: 释放 5 股震荡波
english: Releases 5 waves

chinese: 释放 6 股震荡波
english: Releases 6 waves

chinese:
每 3 次脉冲释放一次强力脉冲
强力脉冲必定暴击
english:
Releases a Stronger Pulse every 3 Pulses
Stronger Pulses always Critically Strike

chinese:
每 5 次脉冲释放一次强力脉冲
强力脉冲必定暴击
english:
Releases a Stronger Pulse every 5 Pulses
Stronger Pulses always Critically Strike

chinese: 基于你的武器，发射一圈投射物，在它们的路径上留下冰缓地面。
english: Releases a circle of projectiles based on your weapon, leaving chilled ground in their wake.

chinese: 释放一个火焰的新星, 有短暂冷却时间.
english: Releases a nova of fire around you, damaging nearby enemies.

chinese: 以你前方的敌人为目标，施放出一道赤色光束，随后连锁弹射至其他敌人，造成物理伤害并施加一个持续物理伤害的减益效果，可以叠加三次。
english: Releases a tendril of blood from your character, which will target an enemy in front of you, then chain to other enemies. The tendril deals physical damage and inflicts a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times.

chinese: 格挡时释放奥术波，每秒最多一次
english: Releases an Arcane Wave on Block no more than once every second

chinese: 以你前方狭小角度内的敌人为目标，施放出数道赤色光束，造成物理伤害并施加一个物理伤害的减益效果，它可以叠加三次。光束可以附加连锁效果。
english: Releases several tendrils of blood from your character, targeting enemies in a narrow angle in front of you. The beams deal physical damage and inflict a physical damage over time debuff to enemies, which can stack up to 3 times. Effects which allow skills to chain can apply to these tendrils.

chinese: 每 0.9 秒释放一次
english: Releases waves every 0.9 seconds

chinese: 从现实中放手。
english: Relinquish your grip on reality.

chinese: 造成伤害后移除冰缓
english: Removes Chill after Damaging

chinese: 攻击不同方向的大片区域。击中敌人的每道瓦尔冲击波都会积累阶段，只要短期内没有击中任何目标就会失去阶段。 限定匕首，爪类，单手剑。
english: Repeatedly attacks a large area in different directions. Each Vaal Reave that hits an enemy grants stages, which you will begin to lose after a short period without hitting anything. Only works with Daggers, Claws, and One-Handed Swords.

chinese: 发射一个定必穿透敌人的你的武器的复制品或是投射物的投射物. 此技能有短暂冷却时间.
english: Repeatedly fires a piercing projectile based on your weapon, converting some physical damage to fire. The projectiles form an arc in front of you.

chinese: 持续吟唱时反复击中前方圆周范围内的敌人，对周围敌人造成伤害。暴击率会随吟唱持续增加。吟唱结束时会根据吟唱的层数额外施放一次击中。限定匕首、爪类、或单手剑。
english: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The critical strike chance is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

chinese: 持续吟唱时反复击中前方圆周范围内的敌人，对周围敌人造成伤害。伤害会随吟唱持续增加。吟唱结束时会根据吟唱的层数额外施放一次击中。限定匕首、爪类、或单手剑。
english: Repeatedly hit enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the enemy. The damage is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional hit for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.

chinese: 不断传送到敌人身边并攻击它们，对其施加割伤但不造成伤害。传送结束后，每个敌人受到身上割伤的总伤害并移除它们的割伤。
english: Repeatedly teleports to enemies and hits them, inflicting a wound but dealing no damage. After the repeating finishes, each enemy is hit by the total damage of their wounds, which are removed.

chinese: 重复 2 次
english: Repeats 2 times

chinese: 重复 1 次
english: Repeats once

chinese:
需要 100 点不羁狂怒
使用时消耗所有不羁狂怒
english:
Requires 100 Unbound Fury
Consumes all Unbound Fury on use

chinese: 基于被辅助的技能保留魔力，使你用法杖发射投射物时触发这些法术。
english: Reserves mana based on the supported spells to cause those spells to trigger when you fire projectiles from a wand attack.

chinese: 根据被辅助的战吼保留魔力，使战吼反复触发。
english: Reserves mana based on the supported warcries to cause those warcries to be repeatedly triggered.

chinese: 通过保留魔力来施加一个增益效果，给你的当前状态施加一个快照。再次施放该法术则让你回到快照时的所有状态，包括快照时的位置、生命、能量护盾等等。
english: Reserves mana to apply a buff and leave afterimages of your recent past. Cast the spell again to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location as well as resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had then.

chinese: 保留部分生命，让你施加的流血效果更强，并根据周围被施加了流血的敌人数量提供生命再生。
english: Reserves some of your life to cause bleeding you inflict to be stronger, and grant life regeneration based on the number bleeding enemies nearby.

chinese: 格挡击中时发起反击，挥出装甲重拳猛击前方的地面，在范围内造成武器伤害。
english: Retaliate against a blocked hit by calling forth a huge armoured fist to slam into the ground in front of you as you do the same, dealing weapon damage in an area.

chinese: 格挡击中时发起反击，使一阵利刃从天而降，落在你的面前。反复造成两把武器合计的伤害。限定双持近战武器。
english: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a hail of blades that rains down in front of you, repeatedly dealing the damage of both your weapons combined. Requires Dual Wielding Melee Weapons.

chinese: 格挡击中时发起反击，迸发出一股神圣能量，产生数道闪电波，从目标位置向外扩散。该技能无法被触发，也不能由图腾、陷阱或地雷使用。
english: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a surge of divine power, causing multiple waves of lightning bursts to expand outward from a targeted location. This skill cannot be Triggered or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 格挡击中时发起反击，用盾牌横扫身前，向前方锥形范围击出一股冰霜波。
english: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of ice in a cone in front of you.

chinese: 在成功格挡一次攻击后进行反击，以盾牌横扫，并在你前方的锥形区域释放一道光波。额外的光波也会从首个被命中的目标周围一定范围内的友军处向目标释放。
english: Retaliate against a blocked hit with a sweep of your Shield, unleashing a wave of light in a cone in front of you. Additional waves will also emanate from allies in a radius around the first target struck, towards that target.

chinese: 格挡击中时发起反击，挥出一道圆弧形的斩击，并释放出两道冲击波。你面前的敌人可以被两道冲击波击中。限定剑类或斧类，以及一面盾牌。
english: Retaliate against a blocked hit with an arcing slash that releases two waves of force. Enemies close in front of you can be hit by both waves. Requires a Sword or Axe and a Shield.

chinese: 受到残暴打击后发起战吼反击，嘲讽周围敌人，吸引他们的进攻，并使自身和周围友军获得一个增益，提高怒火并防止怒火损失。召唤生物无法获得怒火。
english: Retaliate against a savage hit with a warcry, taunting all nearby enemies to attack the user. The user and nearby allies gain a buff which grants rage and prevents rage from being lost. Minions cannot gain rage.

english: Sets a marker at a location. After a short duration, a bolt strikes the marker, dealing physical damage around it and causing bolts to strike at any other markers you've cast. Bolt impacts will leave behind a pool of boiling blood, which deals physical damage over time to enemies within it for a secondary duration.

chinese: 在目标区域设置一个标记. 当标记存在时, 闪电将会随机攻击标记附近的敌人, 对其造成伤害. 该技能的持续时间也会影响闪电发射的间隔。经过一小段时间后, 强力的闪电会攻击那个标记, 并对该标记周围的敌人造成伤害, 同时其他的标记也会陆续受到闪电攻击.
english: Sets a marker at a location. Lightning strikes random enemies around the marker repeatedly over the skill's duration, dealing damage in an area around the strike. Modifiers to the skill's duration will also affect the delay between these strikes. When the duration ends, a large bolt of lightning strikes the marker, dealing damage around it.

chinese: 猛击地面，从空中召唤一柄神圣之锤。命中敌人时，会有另一柄锤子向前落下；若继续命中其他敌人则会重复此过程，直到达到上限。可以消耗一个暴击球以在初始猛击两侧召唤额外的神圣之锤。需要装备锤、短杖或长杖。
english: Slam the ground, calling down a Holy Hammer from above. On hitting an enemy, another Hammer will cascade forward, repeating if further enemies are hit, up to a cap. A Power Charge can be expended to call down additional Hammers to either side of the initial slam. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

chinese: 猛击地面，消耗所有耐力球，在前方制造一道灼热的裂缝，造成范围伤害，并随机分出一些更小的裂缝。需要锤类、短杖、剑类、斧类、长杖或徒手发动。
english: Slam the ground, consuming all Endurance Charges and unleashing a fiery fissure in front of you, dealing area damage and randomly releasing a number of smaller fissures branching off from it. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Sword, Axe, Staff, or Unarmed.

chinese: 砸击地面，消耗所有暴击球，并从天召唤一系列神圣之锤，以向外盘旋的形式倾泻而落。每消耗 1 个暴击球便会额外召唤更多锤子。需要钉锤、短杖或长杖。
english: Slam the ground, consuming all Power Charges and calling down a cascade of holy hammers from above in an outward spiral. Further hammers are called down for each Power Charge consumed. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

chinese: 猛击地面，生成一个向外延伸的同时造成范围伤害的曲折裂缝。裂缝会在抵达目标地点时喷发，喷发之后，裂缝会继续朝敌人移动，造成进一步的喷发。需要斧类、锤类、短杖，长杖或空手。
english: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts dealing damage in an area. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，生成一个向外延伸的同时造成范围伤害的曲折裂缝。裂缝会在抵达目标地点时喷发，释放出熔岩投射物。喷发之后，裂缝会继续朝敌人移动，造成进一步的喷发。需要斧类、锤类、短杖，长杖或空手。
english: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. After erupting, the fissure continues moving towards enemies to cause further eruptions. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，生成一个向外延伸的同时造成范围伤害的曲折裂缝。裂缝会在抵达目标地点时喷发，释放出熔岩投射物。需要斧类、锤类、短杖，长杖或空手。
english: Slam the ground, creating a winding fissure that deals area damage while travelling outwards. When it reaches the target location it erupts, releasing a burst of molten projectiles. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，对递增范围内的敌人造成三段冲击伤害。敌人受到的第二段和第三段伤害的伤害较低，并且只能被一段伤害击中。限定剑类、锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖和空手。
english: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area around the impact in three stages of increasing size. Enemies take slightly less damage on the second and third stage, and can only be hit by one stage. Works with Swords, Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，对范围内的敌人造成伤害。主手武器的猛击会造成更高的伤害。副手武器的猛击效果范围更大。限定双持剑类、锤类、短杖或斧类武器。
english: Slam the ground, damaging enemies in an area. Slams with main hand weapon deal more damage. Slams with off hand weapon have larger area of effect. Requires dual-wielding Swords, Maces, Sceptres, or Axes to use.

chinese: 猛击地面，发出一道长方形裂缝，对敌人造成范围伤害。裂缝尽头会伸出大型尖刺。你或任何友方玩家在尖刺附近使用战吼或其它猛击技能都会让它破碎，对周围敌人造成伤害。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖、徒手发动。
english: Slam the ground, sending out a rectangular fissure that deals area damage to enemies and thrusts a large spike from the ground where it ends. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，发出长方形裂缝，对敌人造成范围伤害。裂缝尽头会伸出尖刺。尖刺会在一段时间后破碎，对周围敌人造成伤害。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖、徒手发动。
english: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. The spikes shatter after a duration, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，发出长方形裂缝，对敌人造成范围伤害。裂缝尽头会伸出尖刺。你或任何友方玩家在尖刺附近使用战吼或其它猛击技能都会让它们破碎，对周围敌人造成伤害。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、杖类、徒手发动。
english: Slam the ground, sending out rectangular fissures that deal area damage to enemies and thrust a spike from the ground when they end. Warcries or other Slam Attacks performed by you or allied players near any spike will cause them to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies. Works with Maces, Sceptres, Axes, Staves and Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，在前方制造一道灼热的裂缝，造成范围伤害，并随机分出一些更小的裂缝。用该技能每三次猛击地面都会消耗一个耐力球。需要锤类、短杖、剑类、斧类、长杖或徒手发动。
english: Slam the ground, unleashing a fiery fissure in front of you, dealing area damage and randomly releasing a number of smaller fissures branching off from it. Consume an Endurance Charge every third time you slam the ground with this skill. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Sword, Axe, Staff, or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击, 攻击, 近战, 效果区域, 辅助
english: Slam, Attack, Melee, AoE, Support

chinese: 猛击, 辅助, 近战, 攻击, 打击
english: Slam, Support, Melee, Attack, Strike

chinese: 重击目标地点。若目标周围有敌人，你可以短距离传送到它旁边，用一道猛击创造一片奉献地面。无法被多重打击辅助。限定剑类、斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖或空手。
english: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 重击目标地点。若目标周围有敌人，你可以短距离传送到它旁边，用一道猛击创造一片奉献地面。消耗一个耐力球能重置其冷却时间。无法被多重打击辅助。限定剑类、斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖或空手。
english: Slams the ground at a targeted location. If an enemy is near where you target, you'll teleport to it from a short distance away, slam, and create an area of consecrated ground. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. Can't be supported by Multistrike, and requires a Sword, Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，制造一道向前的冲击波，对敌人造成伤害，并有较高的几率击晕敌人。敌人距离越近则冲击波伤害越高。需要斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖、徒手发动。
english: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，制造出一道向四面八方扩散的冲击波，对敌人造成伤害并使其晕眩。敌人距离越近则冲击波伤害越高。需要斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖、徒手发动。
english: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wave that travels in all directions that damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. The wave deals more damage to closer enemies. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，制造一道向前的宽阔冲击波，对敌人造成伤害，并有较高的几率击晕敌人。需要双手斧、双手锤或长杖发动。
english: Slams the ground in front of you, creating a wide wave that travels forward and damages enemies with an increased chance to stun. Requires a Two Handed Axe, Two Handed Mace, or Staff.

chinese: 猛击地面，产生一道缓慢的冲击波，按照前进顺序伤害你前方的敌人。一定数量的敌人被冲击波击中后会向周围其它敌人施放伤害性震波。再次使用该技能会使之前的冲击波会停止。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖、徒手发动。
english: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，产生一道冲击波，接连对前方一定范围内的敌人造成伤害。一定数量的敌人被冲击波击中后会向周围其它敌人施放伤害性震波。再次使用该技能会使之前的冲击波停止。当冲击波抵达目标或地形障碍时，若范围内有敌人，可重新锁定目标。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖或徒手。
english: Slams the ground, creating a slow wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Using the skill again will stop the previous wave. When the wave reaches a target or terrain, it can restart aiming towards an enemy, if one is in range. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，产生一道冲击波，接连对前方一定范围内的敌人造成伤害。一定数量的敌人被冲击波击中后会向周围其它敌人施放伤害性震波。需要锤类、短杖、斧类、长杖、徒手发动。
english: Slams the ground, creating a wave of churning terrain that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies around them. Requires a Mace, Sceptre, Axe, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 挥斩两次，释放出对敌人造成伤害的冲击波。在挥斩中间的敌人会被击中两次。限定单手斧或单手剑。
english: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a One Handed Axe or One Handed Sword.

chinese: 挥斩两次，释放出对敌人造成伤害的冲击波。在挥斩中间的敌人会被击中两次。挥斩在血姿态下有一定几率施加流血效果，在沙姿态下拥有更宽的角度。限定斧类和剑类。默认为血姿态。
english: Slashes twice, releasing waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. The slashes will have a chance to inflict bleeding in Blood Stance, or have a wider angle in Sand Stance. Can be used with Axes and Swords. You are in Blood Stance by default.

chinese: 挥斩两次，释放出对敌人造成伤害的宽广冲击波。在挥斩中间的敌人会被击中两次。限定双手斧或双手剑。
english: Slashes twice, releasing wide waves of force that damage enemies they hit. Enemies in the middle of the slashes can be hit by both. Requires a Two Handed Axe or Two Handed Sword.

chinese: 投射物减速(辅)
english: Slower Projectiles

chinese: 重击地面，产生前进的多重尖刺伤害敌人。在血姿态下，多重尖刺会依次爆发，多次击中敌人。在沙姿态下，尖刺会朝外推进。限定剑类或斧类。默认为血姿态。
english: Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spears to damage enemies. When in Blood Stance, multiple spikes burst from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times. In Sand Stance, the spikes are thrust outwards. Requires a Sword or Axe. You are in Blood Stance by default.

chinese:
重击地面，产生接连爆发的多重尖刺，可以击中敌人多次。
限定剑类和斧类。
english:
Smash the ground to bring forth multiple spikes from the ground in sequence, able to hit enemies multiple times.
Requires a Sword or Axe.

chinese: 猛击地面，对周围造成大量伤害，并在地面上留下裂隙。一段时间过后，地面的裂隙将会释放冲击波造成更多的伤害。在冲击波还未释放前再次使用技能不会刷新地面的裂隙。需要斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖、徒手发动。
english: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a duration. Cracks created before the first one has erupted will not generate their own aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 猛击地面，对周围造成大量伤害，并在地面上留下多处裂隙。短时间后，裂隙会喷发出三股强大的震波。使用此技能后，你的脚步会对你周围的区域造成伤害，若之前的裂隙已经喷发，则会再次造成裂隙。该效果会在第二次持续结束后消退，或是在震波喷发至最大数量后消退。需要斧类、锤类、短杖、长杖、徒手发动。
english: Smashes the ground, dealing damage in an area and cracking the earth. The crack will erupt in a powerful aftershock after a short duration. After using this skill, your steps will deal damage around you, cracking the earth if the previous cracks have erupted. This effect ends after a secondary duration, or after a maximum number of aftershocks. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, Staff or Unarmed.

chinese: 生成 5 个灵柩

chinese: 当你移动时，根据当前区域中的怪物，身边会生成灵柩。若你正在使用召唤灵体技能时，则有几率生成体相同的灵体灵柩。灵体灵柩无法与非召唤生物技能互动。
english: Spawns corpses around you while you move, based on monsters in the current area. If you are using the Raise Spectre skill there is a chance to spawn spectral corpses matching your most recently raised Spectres. Spectral corpses cannot be interacted with except by Minion skills.

chinese: 消耗部分魔力，获得一个增益效果，在耗尽前承受部分击中伤害。该增益根据该技能消耗的魔力数量获得额外闪电伤害。和其它防卫技能共用冷却时间。
english: Spends a portion of your mana to grant a buff that takes some of the damage from hits for you until depleted. The buff grants added lightning damage based on the amount of mana spent by this skill. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

chinese: 以自体为中心在原地进行旋转攻击，周围的敌人将会被拉向你并受到伤害。使用此技能时，无法被晕眩或被击退，无法被无情辅助。
english: Spin and attack in place, damaging nearby enemies and pulling others towards you. While using this skill, you cannot be stunned or knocked back. Cannot be supported by Ruthless.

chinese: 用刀剑或斧类施放旋转攻击，若你拥有至少 10 点怒火，则会产生一道附着于你的怒火风暴，根据你的攻击速度反复对其中的敌人造成攻击伤害。怒火风暴消耗怒火的速度之间加快，并在耗尽怒火时结束。
english: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. If you have at least 10 rage, create a ragestorm attached to you that repeatedly deals attack damage to enemies inside based on your attack speed. The ragestorm consumes rage at an accelerating rate, and ends if you run out.

chinese: 用刀剑或斧类施放旋转攻击，对周围范围内的敌人造成伤害。牺牲部分怒火可以朝前方发射一道怒火风暴。在怒火风暴内的敌人会降低移动速度，并根据你的攻击速度反复承受攻击伤害。
english: Spin with a sword or axe to deal damage in an area around you. Sacrifices some rage to send a ragestorm forward. While enemies are inside it, the ragestorm will slow its movement and repeatedly deal attack damage based on your attack speed.

english: Summon a Chilling Skitterbot and a Shocking Skitterbot, which will trigger your traps and detonate your mines. Mines detonated by Skitterbots will re-arm and can then be detonated again. The Skitterbots grant you more trap and mine damage, and cannot be targeted or damaged.

chinese: 召唤一个停留在你身旁的圣物。当你使用攻击击中敌人，圣物会触发一个新星法术，对敌人造成物理伤害并为周围友军提供生命再生。召唤生物受到的生命再生效果更高。圣物的新星法术冷却时间很短。
english: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a nova spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies and grants life regeneration to allies in an area around it. This life regeneration is higher when applied to minions.

chinese: 召唤一个停留在你身旁的圣物。当你使用攻击击中敌人，圣物会触发一个法术，对附近一名敌人周围的所有敌人造成物理伤害。圣物的法术冷却时间很短。
english: Summon a Holy Relic that stays near you. When you hit an enemy with an attack, the Holy Relic triggers a spell with a short cooldown, that deals physical damage to enemies in an area around a nearby enemy.

chinese: 召唤两个跟随你的食骨者。食骨者会吞噬它们途经的灵柩，在吞噬 10 具灵柩后创建一个临时光环。其中一个食骨者会创建诅咒光环，如时空锁链、衰弱或惩戒，且无视诅咒上限；另一个食骨者会创建光环，使敌人的击中伤害变得不幸。
english: Summon two Bone Feeders which follow you around. Bone Feeders consume corpses they walk over, creating a temporary Aura after consuming 10 corpses. One Bone Feeder creates a Curse Aura of either Temporal Chains, Enfeeble or Punishment that ignores Curse Limits. The other Bone Feeder creates an Aura that causes Enemy Damage with Hits to be Unlucky.

chinese: 召唤一个兽化恐喙鸟。兽化恐喙鸟能进行近战攻击并拥有冲锋技能，而且附带能威吓敌人的光环。兽化恐喙鸟的攻击无法被闪避。敌人将不会直接攻击该召唤生物，并且它们对伤害免疫。
english: Summons a Bestial Rhoa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Rhoa uses a charge and has an aura that intimidates enemies. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.

chinese: 召唤一个兽化巨蛇。兽化巨蛇的攻击能射出强大的混沌投射物。敌人将不会直接攻击该召唤生物，并且它们对伤害免疫。
english: Summons a Bestial Snake. The Bestial Snake fires powerful chaos projectile attacks. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.

chinese: 召唤一个兽化之爪。兽化之爪能进行近战攻击并拥有裂地之击技能，而且附带激励战吼。敌人将不会直接攻击该召唤生物，并且它们对伤害免疫。
english: Summons a Bestial Ursa. In addition to its melee attack, the Bestial Ursa uses a powerful Ground Slam and Rallying Cry. Enemies will not engage this minion directly, and they are immune to damage.

chinese: 召唤一个腐化魔像，给非魔像召唤生物附加物理伤害。这种魔像可以挥出伤害递增，速度越来越快的破空斩，还可以发出骸骨突刺。并使它附近每个非魔像召唤生物造成更多伤害。
english: Summons a Carrion Golem that grants added physical damage for your non-golem minions. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.

chinese: 召唤一个腐化魔像。腐化魔像可以挥出伤害递增，速度越来越快的破空斩，还可以发出骸骨突刺。
english: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, as well as a cascade of bone spikes.

chinese: 召唤一个腐化魔像。腐化魔像可以挥出伤害递增，速度越来越快的破空斩，可以消耗灵柩来治疗自己，并获得发出毁灭性骸骨突刺的能力。附近每个非魔像召唤生物可以使它造成更多伤害。
english: Summons a Carrion Golem. The Carrion Golem attacks with a series of slashes that increase in speed and damage, can consume corpses to heal itself and gain the ability to unleash a devastating cascade of bone spikes, and deals more damage for each of your non-golem minions near it.

chinese: 召唤一个混沌魔像，启动时使你获得持续伤害和混沌抗性。除了一般的近战攻击外，混沌魔像会施放一个造成持续伤害的混沌光环和混沌之刺。
english: Summons a Chaos Golem that grants you damage over time and chaos resistance. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.

chinese: 召唤一个混沌魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，混沌魔像会施放一个造成持续伤害的混沌光环和混沌之刺。
english: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a damage over time Chaos aura and a cascade of Chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack.

chinese: 召唤一个混沌魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，混沌魔像会施放一个造成高额持续伤害并施加死亡凋零的混沌光环。
english: Summons a Chaos Golem. The Chaos Golem can cast a powerful damage over time Chaos aura that Withers enemies in addition to its melee attack.

chinese: 召唤一个烈焰魔像，启动时会提高你的伤害和效果区域。烈焰魔像会施放火焰放射，火焰波浪，还会射出会爆炸的弧状移动投射物。
english: Summons a Flame Golem that grants you increased Damage and Area of Effect. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.

chinese: 召唤一个烈焰魔像。烈焰魔像会施放火焰放射，火焰波浪，还会射出会爆炸的弧状移动投射物。
english: Summons a Flame Golem. The Flame Golem can cast a fire spray, a wave of fire damage, and an explosive arcing projectile.

chinese: 召唤一个烈焰魔像。烈焰魔像被召唤时从天而降，撞击时造成范围伤害并留下燃烧地面。落地后会施放火焰放射和火焰波浪。
english: Summons a Flame Golem. When summoned, the Flame Golem attacks by falling from the sky, dealing fire damage in an area and leaving burning ground around the impact. After landing, it can cast a fire spray and a wave of fire damage.

chinese: 召唤一个闪电魔像，给予你额外的攻击、施法速度和魔力再生。魔像会对敌人进行雷击，召唤会电击敌人的闪电球，并施放一个为魔像及其周围友军的法术和攻击附加闪电伤害的临时光环。
english: Summons a Lightning Golem that grants you increased attack and cast speed, and mana regeneration. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.

chinese: 召唤一个闪电魔像。魔像会射出投射物法术，召唤会电击敌人的闪电球，并施放一个为魔像及其周围友军的法术和攻击附加闪电伤害的临时光环。
english: Summons a Lightning Golem. The Lightning Golem fires a projectile spell, creates orbs of Lightning that zap nearby enemies, and casts a temporary aura that grants added Lightning Damage to spells and attacks used by the Golem and its nearby allies.

chinese: 召唤一个幻灵，它会使用造成物理伤害的穿透投射物法术。
english: Summons a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage.

chinese: 召唤一个追命死灵，它会施放多种区域攻击。追命死灵会削弱你的其它非追命死灵的召唤生物，还会消耗它们以治疗并暂时强化自己。
english: Summons a Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The presence of any Reapers weakens your other non-Reaper minions, and Reapers will consume them to temporarily empower and heal themselves.

chinese: 在你身旁召唤一个随机元素的遗物。根据选择的元素，遗物召唤生物会具有愤怒、憎恨或雷霆光环。遗物被击败时爆炸，对周围的敌人造成元素伤害。如果你已拥有该元素的遗物，则会刷新它的持续时间，而非召唤一个新的遗物。
english: Summons a Relic of a random element that stays near you. Depending on the element chosen, the relic minion will have an Anger, Hatred, or Wrath aura. These relics explode when they die, dealing elemental damage to enemies around them. If you already have a relic of the chosen element, its duration will be refreshed instead of summoning a new one.

chinese: 召唤一个跟随你的光辉哨兵，它会攻击近战范围内的敌人，使周围的敌人燃烧，并替你承受一定比例的击中伤害。你只能拥有一个光辉哨兵。
english: Summons a Sentinel of Radiance which follows you and attacks enemies in melee, while burning enemies around it and taking a portion of damage from hits for you. You can only have one Sentinel of Radiance.

chinese: 召唤一头幽虎同伴攻击周围的敌人，持续一段时间后消失。每头幽虎都会给你提供增益效果，可以增加暴击几率，并提升攻击和施法速度。达到召唤上限时使用会刷新其中一头幽虎的生命和持续时间。
english: Summons a Spectral Tiger Companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each Spectral Tiger grants you a buff that increases Critical Strike Chance, and increases Attack and Cast Speed. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.

chinese: 召唤一个为你提供额外生命回复和防御的巨石魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，巨石魔像会使用滚动冲撞，还有沉重的冲击波来嘲讽附近的敌人。
english: Summons a Stone Golem that grants you life regeneration and defences. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

chinese: 召唤一个巨石魔像，你受到敌人击中物理伤害的一定比例由其生命承担。除了一般的近战攻击外，巨石魔像会使用滚动冲撞，还有沉重的猛击来嘲讽附近的敌人。
english: Summons a Stone Golem that takes a portion of the melee damage you recieve from enemy hits from its life before yours. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

chinese: 召唤一个巨石魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，巨石魔像会使用滚动冲撞，还有沉重的猛击来嘲讽附近的敌人。
english: Summons a Stone Golem. In addition to its melee attack, the Stone Golem uses a rolling charge and a powerful slam that can taunt enemies.

chinese: 召唤一个嘲讽装置，嘲讽周围的敌人。
english: Summons a Taunting Contraption that taunts nearby enemies to attack it.

chinese: 召唤一个使用该技能的图腾
english: Summons a Totem which uses this Skill

chinese:
召唤一个发射分叉箭矢的弩炮图腾。
需要弓类武器。
english:
Summons a ballista totem that attacks with forking arrows.
Requires a Bow.

chinese: 召唤一个发射穿刺箭矢的弩炮图腾。需要弓类武器。
english: Summons a ballista totem that attacks with piercing arrows. Requires a Bow.

chinese: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，消耗钢刃碎片以发射多重箭矢，在巨力作用下分裂成散弹。敌人可以同时被多重箭矢击中。需要弓类武器。钢刃碎片由【钢铁呼唤】提供。
english: Summons a ballista totem that consumes your Steel Shards to fire multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

chinese: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，发射多重箭矢，在巨力作用下分裂成散弹。敌人可以同时被多重箭矢击中。需要弓类武器。
english: Summons a ballista totem that fires multiple arrows with extreme force, breaking them apart into shrapnel. Enemies can be hit by multiple arrows from the same attack. Requires a Bow.

chinese: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，朝空中猛烈发射多支箭矢，每支以一个敌人为目标。箭矢落地时对周围的敌人造成范围伤害。需要弓类武器。
english: Summons a ballista totem that propels a number of fiery arrows into the air, each targeting a specific enemy. Arrows deal area damage to enemies around it on landing. Requires a Bow.

chinese: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，朝空中猛烈发射一连串箭矢。这些箭矢以一条直线击中地面，每一支都对周围的敌人造成范围伤害。需要弓类武器。
english: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in a line, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.

chinese: 召唤一个弩炮图腾，朝空中猛烈发射一连串箭矢。这些箭矢沿两条垂直线条击中地面，每一支都对周围的敌人造成范围伤害。需要弓类武器。
english: Summons a ballista totem that propels a sequence of fiery arrows into the air. The arrows impact the ground in two perpendicular lines, each dealing area damage to enemies around it. Requires a Bow.

chinese: 召唤一支裂隙虫群怪物大军为你作战。这些被召唤的怪物会将其全部物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。
english: Summons a horde of Hiveborn Breach monsters to do your bidding. These summoned monsters have all their physical damage converted to cold.

chinese: 召唤一个强力的追命死灵，它会被动地跟随你，不会攻击敌人。追命死灵会削弱你的其它召唤生物，还会消耗它们以治疗并暂时强化自己。召唤追命死灵后再施放该技能可以让它冲向目标地点施放一次强力攻击。不能被触发或受“施法回响”和“释出”辅助，不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用。
english: Summons a powerful Reaper which passively follows you without attacking enemies. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack. Cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 召唤一个强力的追命死灵，它会施放凌厉的区域攻击。追命死灵会削弱你的其它召唤生物，偶尔还会消耗它们来强化自己，并给自己回血。召唤追命死灵后再施放该技能可以让它冲向目标地点施放一次强力攻击。
english: Summons a powerful Reaper which uses a variety of slashing area attacks. The Reaper's presence weakens your other minions, and it will consume them to temporarily empower and heal itself. Using this skill while the Reaper is already summoned causes it to dash to the targeted location and perform a powerful attack.

chinese: 在目标地点周围召唤一圈弩炮图腾。这些弩炮会向目标地点射击一次后消失。需要弓类武器。
english: Summons a ring of ballista totems around a targeted location. These ballistae fire once at the targeted location and then expire. Requires a Bow.

chinese: 召唤只能存在极短时间的愤怒狂灵，这些火焰魔侍将会冲至敌人身边并快速的进行攻击，并将其造成的所有物理伤害转化为火焰伤害。敌方生物将不会主动攻击这些狂灵，并可以穿越它们。
english: Summons a short-lived flaming skull that rushes at nearby enemies and attacks them rapidly, converting all its physical damage to fire. Enemies will not directly engage these spirits, and can pass through them.

chinese: 召唤一头幽狼伙伴攻击周围的敌人，持续一段时间后消失。每头幽狼都会给你提供增加攻击伤害的增益效果。达到召唤上限时使用会刷新其中一头的生命和持续时间。
english: Summons a spectral wolf companion that attacks nearby enemies and dies after a duration. Each spectral wolf grants you a buff that adds damage to your attacks. If you have the maximum number of them, refreshes the duration and life of an existing one instead.

chinese: 召唤一个图腾, 它会吞噬附近的灵柩并为你回复生命.
english: Summons a totem that can consume nearby corpses. If you are hurt, it will destroy a corpse to leech life to you.

chinese: 召唤一个图腾, 它会与你和你所操控的所有图腾之间产生火焰连接, 经过火焰连接或是靠近火焰连接尾端的敌人将会受到燃烧伤害.
english: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage.

chinese: 召唤一个图腾，向你和你操控的其他图腾发射一道火焰光束，使被光束击中的敌人受到燃烧伤害。光束两端附近的敌人也会受到燃烧伤害。达到最大激活图腾数量时，该技能召唤的所有图腾将引爆，并在一段时间内对敌人施加相同的燃烧伤害。
english: Summons a totem that casts a beam of fire at you and each other totem you control, dealing burning damage to enemies caught in the beam. Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. Reaching maximum active totem count will cause all totems from this skill to detonate, applying the same burning damage for a duration.

chinese: 召唤一个图腾，它会持续对附近的敌人喷射火焰，并在图腾周围创造一片奉献地面。
english: Summons a totem that channels to fire a stream of flame at nearby enemies, and creates an area of consecrated ground around the totem.

chinese: 召唤一个带有光环的图腾，为你和周围的友军提供生命再生。
english: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies.

chinese: 召唤一个带有光环的图腾，为你和周围的友军提供生命再生。受光环影响的对象被击中时，图腾会损失生命来承担部分伤害。
english: Summons a totem that has an aura which regenerates life for you and your nearby allies. When things affected by the aura are hit, the totem's life is removed instead for some of the damage.

chinese: 召唤一个图腾, 它会持续的震动附近的地面, 击退附近的敌人并造成伤害.
english: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around it, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies

chinese: 召唤一个图腾，它会持续震动附近的地面，对敌人造成伤害。
english: Summons a totem that shakes the earth around you, damaging enemies.

chinese: 召唤一个图腾，它会持续的嘲讽周围的敌人对其进行攻击.
english: Summons a totem that taunts nearby monsters to attack it.

chinese: 召唤一个寒冰魔像，启动时会提高你的暴击和命中。除了一般的近战攻击外，寒冰魔像会施放寒冰弹幕和冰缓回旋攻击。
english: Summons an Ice Golem that grants you increased Critical Strike Chance and Accuracy. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.

chinese: 召唤一个寒冰魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，寒冰魔像会施放寒冰弹幕和冰缓回旋攻击。
english: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack.

chinese: 召唤一个寒冰魔像。除了一般的近战攻击外，寒冰魔像会施放寒冰弹幕和冰缓回旋攻击。它会在低血时触发一个自毁法术，造成范围伤害并发射环形的冰霜投射物。
english: Summons an Ice Golem. The Ice Golem can use an icy barrage spell and a chilling spinning attack in addition to its melee attack. If reduced to low life it will trigger a spell that destroys itself to deal area damage and fire icy projectiles in a circle.

chinese: 召唤一支由强大的魔侍将军所统率，由魔侍兵，魔侍弓箭手与魔侍法师所组成的魔侍大军。
english: Summons an army of skeletal soldiers, archers and mages, led by a powerful general.

chinese: 召唤一个德瑞的雕像，该雕像会在一个范围内投射插在德瑞之肤上的所有诅咒技能。这些诅咒的效能较弱。
english: Summons an effigy of Doedre, which will project auras of all the curse skill gems socketed in Doedre's Skin. These curses have less effectiveness.

chinese: 召唤一个不朽的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放两个下列增益法术：秘术增强，加快施法速度并提高魔力再生率，以及一个有几率导致感电并穿透闪电抗性的增益效果。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion has two buff spells it will cast on you: Arcane Surge, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration, and a buff that grants Chance to Shock and Lightning Penetration.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会对你施放随机增益，附加以下任意一个或全部效果：发射 1 个额外投射物，连锁 +1，投射物穿透 1 个额外目标，或者投射物分裂时额外分裂一次。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: 1 additional Projectile, +1 Chain, Pierce 1 additional Target, or Projectiles Fork.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会对你施放随机增益，附加以下任意一个或全部效果：发射 2 个额外投射物，额外连锁 2 次，投射物穿透 2 个额外目标，或者投射物分裂时额外分裂一次。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will cast a random buff on you that grants one or all of the following: Fire 2 additional Projectiles, Chain 2 additional times, Projectiles Pierce 2 additional targets, or Projectiles Fork then Fork an additional time.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的冰雷先驱者. 先驱者偶尔会冰缓或感电敌人并连锁到附近的敌人.
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会偶尔对敌人施加提高效果的冰缓或感电效果，并连锁给周围其它敌人。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally apply a Chill or Shock with increased effect to an enemy that chains to other nearby enemies.

chinese: 召唤一个不朽的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放秘术增强，提高施法速度和魔力再生率。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally cast Arcane Surge on you, granting increased Cast Speed and Mana Regeneration.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放光环，增加你和你周围所有队友的行动速度。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you and all allies near you.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会偶尔对你施放光环，增加你和你周围所有敌我单位的行动速度。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. The minion will occasionally create an aura on you that increases the Action Speed of you, and all allies and enemies near you.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。当你周围有稀有或传奇敌人时，它会偶尔给你提供一个增益效果，大幅提高伤害、攻击速度和移动速度，并降低你受到的伤害。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, and reducing the Damage you take.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。当你周围有稀有或传奇敌人时，它会偶尔给你提供一个增益效果，大幅提高伤害、攻击速度和移动速度，降低你受到的伤害。并使被你击败的敌人爆炸，造成其生命上限 10% 的物理伤害。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. When you are near a rare or unique enemy, the minion will occasionally grant you a buff giving significantly increased Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed, reducing the Damage you take, and causing Bleeding Enemies that you Kill to Explode, dealing 10% of their maximum Life as Physical Damage.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的不屈先驱者。在你持续吟唱时, 先驱者偶尔会对你施放一个增益, 减少你受到的伤害, 使你免疫所有晕眩和元素异常状态。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, and makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的先驱者。它会在你持续吟唱时偶尔会对你施放一个增益效果，减少你受到的伤害，使你避免所有晕眩和元素异常状态，并免受诅咒影响。
english: Summons an immortal Harbinger minion. While you are channelling, the minion will occasionally cast a buff on you that reduces the Damage you take, makes you avoid all Stuns and Elemental Ailments, and prevents Curses affecting you.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的亚欧红古部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，提升旅行技能的冷却回复速度。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Arohongui tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes travel skills recover cooldowns faster. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的辛格拉部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，使你获得魔力再生。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Hinekora tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which regenerates mana. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的奇塔弗部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，使一定比例的生命偷取立即生效。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Kitava tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which makes a percentage of your leech recover instantly. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的努葛玛呼部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，让图腾替你承受部分击中伤害。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ngamahu tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which allows totems to take some damage from hits for you. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的雷默科部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，压制法术时能阻挡更多伤害。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Ramako tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which prevents additional damage from suppressed spells. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的隆戈库莱部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，让你的部分护甲值能够抵御所有伤害类型。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Rongokurai tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which lets a percentage of your armour protect against all damage types. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的塔萨里奥部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，使你的行动速度无法被降低。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tasalio tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which prevents your action speed being lowered. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的塔赫亚部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，补充你的药剂。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tawhoa tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which refills flasks. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的图克哈玛部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，使你获得怒火再生。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Tukohama tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which regenerates rage. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤一个不死的瓦拉克部落酋长，与你并肩作战一段时间。该召唤生物会给你提供一个增益效果，在你格挡时回复生命、魔力和能量护盾。与其他酋长之魂技能共用冷却时间。
english: Summons an immortal chieftain minion of the Valako tribe to fight alongside you for a duration. This minion grants you a buff which recovers life, mana and energy shield when you block. Shares a Cooldown with other Spirit Chieftain Skills.

chinese: 召唤出一片由抓握之手组成的领域，每只手都握着一枚会削弱敌人的雷电法球。当敌人靠近一只手时，其所握的法球会爆炸，造成闪电伤害。
english: Summons forth a field of grasping hands, each of which clutches an orb of lightning. When an enemy is near a hand, the orb it clutches will detonate to deal lightning spell damage.

chinese: 召唤一个寒冰的颅骨，在持续时间结束时爆炸。此技能有短暂冷却时间。
english: Summons three icy skull minions that explode at the end of their duration.

chinese: 召唤三个不会受到伤害的幽鬼之灵快速冲向并攻击附近的敌人. 敌人无法解除幽鬼之灵, 并且可以穿过幽鬼之灵.
english: Summons three invulnerable spectral skulls that rush at nearby enemies and attack them rapidly. Enemies will not engage these spirits, and can pass through them.
