enemy Hit by each Attack they Exert

chinese:
被辅助战吼的冷却时间结束时触发
该技能的魔力保留为被辅助技能的魔力保留的总和，并且无法被进一步修改
english:
Supported Warcries will Trigger when their Cooldown is over
This Skill's Mana Reservation is the total of the Mana Reservations of Supported Skills, and cannot be further modified

chinese: 辅助攻击类技能，使你在移动一定距离后，攻击命中时触发风爆术。无法辅助已被触发的技能，或由你之外的其他单位使用的技能。无法修改召唤物的技能。
english: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to trigger Windburst on hit after you've travelled a certain distance. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助捷技能，使其获得更高的暴击率，但失去增益效果。
english: Supports Herald skills causing them to have higher critical strike chance but no buff effect.

chinese: 辅助你亲自施放的投射物法术。无法辅助法球技能、触发类技能、烙印技能、瓦尔技能、持续吟唱技能、带保留效果的技能，或非你亲自使用的技能。
english: Supports Projectile Spells you cast yourself. Cannot support orb skills, triggered skills, brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by things other than you.

chinese: 辅助可造成伤害击中的技能，使其在造成闪电伤害时触发召唤活体闪电。无法辅助图腾、陷阱或地雷使用的技能。不能修改召唤物的技能。
english: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits, causing them to trigger Summon Living Lightning when dealing lightning damage. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of Minions.

chinese: 辅助猛击技能。无法辅助触发技能或由除你之外的来源使用的技能。
english: Supports Slam skills. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you.

chinese: 辅助瓦尔技能。
english: Supports Vaal skills.

chinese: 辅助瓦尔法术技能，使其在施放时重复，但代价是消耗你的生命与能量护盾。无法辅助图腾技能、持续吟唱技能、触发类技能、瞬发技能、反击技能、闪现技能或带有保留效果的技能。
english: Supports Vaal spell skills, making them repeat when cast at the cost of your life and energy shield. Cannot support totem skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

chinese: 辅助法杖攻击，使其在暴击时有一定几率触发念动紊流。无法辅助触发技能或非你本人使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports Wand Attacks, granting them a chance to trigger Kinetic Flux on critical strike. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助法杖攻击，使其在击败时有几率触发念动紊流。无法辅助触发类技能或非你本人使用的技能。无法影响召唤物的技能。
english: Supports Wand Attacks, granting them a chance to trigger Kinetic Flux on kill. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助非触发的战吼技能。被辅助的战吼将生成奉献地面，但会降低效果范围与冷却回复速度。
english: Supports Warcries that are not triggered. Supported Warcries create Consecrated Ground, but have lowered area of effect and cooldown recovery.

chinese: 辅助任意弓类或法杖技能，改为召唤一个弩炮图腾，替你施放该技能。
english: Supports any bow or wand attack skill, causing it to summon a ballista totem that uses the skill for you.

chinese: 辅助任何吟唱技能，在你持续吟唱时保护你。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports any channelling skill, protecting you from damage while you channel it. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助具有保留效果的非祝福技能。
english: Supports any non-blessing skill with a reservation.

chinese: 辅助任意非祝福技能。召唤生物不能获得赤炼效果。
english: Supports any non-blessing skill. Minions cannot gain the Lifetap buff.

chinese:
辅助所有技能宝石。
无法辅助非源自宝石的技能。
english:
Supports any skill gem.
Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

chinese: 辅助任意技能，当该宝石达到 2 级或以上时，对被辅助技能施加消耗和保留加成。无法辅助非技能宝石带来的技能。
english: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will apply a cost & reservation multiplier to supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

chinese: 辅助任意技能，当该宝石达到 2 级或以上时，提升被辅助技能的等级。无法辅助非技能宝石带来的技能。
english: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the level of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

chinese: 辅助任意技能，当该宝石达到 2 级或以上时，提升被辅助技能的品质。无法辅助非技能宝石带来的技能。
english: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

chinese: 辅助可使敌人冰缓或产生冰缓区域的技能。
english: Supports any skill that can chill enemies or create chilling areas.

chinese: 辅助任意能击败敌人的技能。
english: Supports any skill that can kill enemies.

chinese: 辅助任意能造成伤害或有持续时间的技能。
english: Supports any skill that deals damage or has a duration.

chinese: 辅助任意造成伤害的技能。
english: Supports any skill that deals damage.

chinese: 辅助任意有持续时间或能通过击中造成异常状态的技能。
english: Supports any skill that has a duration, or can hit enemies to inflict ailments on them.

chinese: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能。
english: Supports any skill that has a duration.

chinese: 辅助任意可以击中敌人或施加异常状态的技能
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies or inflicts ailments

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，基于击中造成的伤害偷取能量护盾。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing those hits to leech energy shield based on damage dealt.

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，基于击中造成的伤害偷取生命。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing those hits to leech life based on damage dealt.

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使被辅助技能更容易眩晕敌人。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making it easier to stun enemies with those skills.

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的冰霜抗性。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的元素抗性。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的火焰抗性。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy fire resistance.

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，使击中能穿透敌人的闪电抗性。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy lightning resistance.

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，或能直接造成燃烧伤害的技能。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or can deal burning damage directly.

chinese: 辅助任意能击中敌人或对敌人造成元素异常状态的技能。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies, or could otherwise apply elemental ailments.

chinese: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能，如果敌人在被击中后低于 10% 生命上限值则会被立即击败。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If enemies are left below 10% of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.

chinese: 辅助任何能击中敌人的技能。若普通或魔法怪物被这些技能击中后，其剩余生命值低于一定百分比，则会被直接斩杀。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If normal or magic enemies are left below a percentage of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.

chinese: 辅助任意击中敌人的技能。召唤生物无法获得凌厉。
english: Supports any skill that hits enemies. Minions cannot gain Cruelty.

chinese: 辅助能击中或燃烧敌人的技能，以及能施加元素异常状态的技能。
english: Supports any skill that hits or burns enemies, or inflicts elemental ailments.

chinese: 辅助任意有持续时间的技能。
english: Supports any skill with a duration.

chinese: 辅助任意有范围效果的技能，不论该技能是否造成伤害。
english: Supports any skill with an area of effect, regardless of whether that skill deals damage.

chinese: 辅助任意有范围效果的技能。
english: Supports any skill with an area of effect.

chinese: 辅助任意你用来击中敌人的技能。无法辅助图腾，陷阱和地雷所施放的技能。
english: Supports any skill you use to hit enemies yourself. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

chinese: 辅助任意技能。召唤生物、图腾、陷阱、地雷无法获得启迪球。
english: Supports any skill. Minions, Totems, Traps and Mines cannot gain Inspiration Charges.

chinese: 辅助并非被触发施放的攻击技能。
english: Supports attack skills that aren't triggered.

chinese: 辅助法杖可以使用的攻击技能。无法辅助瓦尔技能，召唤生物技能，位移技能或图腾，陷阱和地雷使用的技能。
english: Supports attack skills that can be used with Wands. Cannot support Vaal skills, minion skills, movement skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

chinese: 辅助弓类可以使用的攻击技能。被辅助的技能只能用弓才能生效。无法辅助瓦尔技能，召唤生物技能，位移技能或图腾，陷阱和地雷使用的技能。
english: Supports attack skills that can be used with bows. Supported skills can only be used with bows. Cannot support Vaal skills, minion skills, movement skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

chinese: 辅助发射投射物的攻击技能，使力量属性也会像提高近战物理伤害一样提高投射物物理伤害。
english: Supports attack skills that fire projectiles, making the increase to physical melee damage from strength also increase their physical projectile damage.

chinese: 辅助击中敌人的攻击技能，基于击中造成的伤害偷取魔力。
english: Supports attack skills that hit enemies, causing those hits to leech mana based on damage dealt.

chinese: 辅助使用弓类或法杖发射投射物的攻击技能。你不再使用被辅助的技能，而是投掷地雷。引爆地雷时，地雷会对你所在的位置使用该技能。地雷无法使用吟唱技能。
english: Supports attack skills that use bows or wands and fire projectiles ahead. Instead of using that skill, you will throw mines that will use the skill for you when you detonate them, targeting your location. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

chinese: 辅助攻击技能，或其它能使敌人瘫痪的技能。
english: Supports attack skills, or other skills that can maim enemies.

chinese: 辅助能造成伤害的攻击或法术技能。
english: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.

chinese: 辅助攻击技能，当你满血时该技能造成的所有伤害提高。
english: Supports attack skills, providing a bonus to all damage dealt by those skills while your life is full.

chinese: 辅助攻击技能。
english: Supports attack skills.

chinese: 辅助攻击技能。无法辅助召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.

chinese: 辅助攻击技能。无法辅助触发技能、召唤生物技能，以及图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。
english: Supports attack skills. Cannot support triggered skills, skills which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps or mines.

chinese: 辅助攻击，使其触发棱光魔爆法术。不能辅助触发攻击技能或除你之外的生物使用的攻击技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports attacks, causing them to trigger the Prismatic Burst spell. Cannot support triggered attacks or attacks used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助影响你和友军的光环技能，提高光环对友军的效果，但使其无法作用于你。无法辅助诅咒类光环，或其他只影响敌人的光环。无法辅助图腾所施放的技能。不能调整召唤生物技能。
english: Supports aura skills that affect you and allies, increasing the aura's effect on allies, but preventing it from affecting you at all. Cannot support curse auras, or other auras that only affect enemies. Cannot support skills used by totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助在你周围产生永久性效果的光环技能，将它们的保留效果变为具有消耗的暂时性效果，不能辅助旗帜技能和姿态技能。
english: Supports aura skills that create permanent auras around you, changing their reservation to a cost and making them temporary. Cannot support banner or stance skills.

chinese: 辅助保留生命或魔力并在你周围产生光环的技能。
english: Supports aura skills that reserve life or mana to create auras around you.

chinese: 辅助旗帜技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports banner skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助将箭矢像投射物一般向前发射的弓箭攻击技能。被辅助技能改为朝空中射出一支负载箭矢，落到目标地点。然后向外射出一圈箭矢。不能辅助原本就朝空中射击的技能、吟唱技能或召唤生物技能。
english: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

chinese: 辅助弓箭攻击技能，当你在其他弓箭攻击上花费足够魔力时触发它们。无法影响召唤生物的技能。不能辅助图腾、陷阱、地雷、瓦尔技能或吟唱技能
english: Supports bow attack skills, causing them to trigger when you've spent enough mana in total on other bow attacks. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Cannot support totems, traps, mines, Vaal skills, or channelling skills

chinese: 辅助弓类攻击技能。无法辅助引导技能、瞬发技能、瓦尔技能，或由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。
english: Supports bow attack skills. Cannot support channelled skills, instant skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

chinese: 辅助可被召回的烙印技能。
english: Supports brand skills that can be recalled.

chinese: 辅助你自己施放的持续吟唱法术，随着施法时间的提高大幅增强被辅助技能的伤害与消耗。无法修改召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports channelling spells you cast yourself, significantly empowering their damage the longer they are channelled for, while also raising their cost. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能，使魔蛊在结束时触发【末日爆炸】。不能辅助触发型和光环类诅咒技能。
english: Supports hex curse skills, causing them to trigger Doom Blast when the hex ends. Cannot support curse skills which are triggered or applied as an aura.

chinese: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能，将其变为光环，并将它的效果施加给你周围的所有敌人。
english: Supports hex curse skills, turning them into auras that will apply their effect to all enemies in an area around you.

chinese: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能。
english: Supports hex curse skills.

chinese: 辅助魔蛊诅咒技能，光环或诅咒区域的魔蛊无法被转移。
english: Supports hex curse skills. Hexes from auras or cursed ground cannot transfer.

chinese: 辅助羁绊技能。
english: Supports link skills.

chinese: 辅助印记诅咒技能。
english: Supports mark curse skills.

chinese: 辅助并非被触发施放的近战攻击技能。
english: Supports melee attack skills that are not triggered.

chinese: 辅助可以被增助的近战攻击技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。瓦尔技能和持续吟唱技能无法被增助。
english: Supports melee attack skills which can be exerted. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Vaal skills and channelling skills cannot be exerted.

chinese: 辅助没有冷却时间的近战攻击技能。这些技能由将军战吼召唤的幻影武士使用。被辅助技能无法被多重打击辅助。
english: Supports melee attack skills without a cooldown. Those skills will be used by Mirage Warriors summoned by General's Cry. Supported skills cannot be supported by Multistrike.

chinese: 辅助你亲自施放的近战攻击技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports melee attack skills you use yourself. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助近战攻击技能，使该技能对流血敌人造成更多伤害，但该技能无法再使敌人流血。
english: Supports melee attack skills, causing them to deal more damage against bleeding enemies, but preventing those skills from inflicting bleeding on enemies in any way.

chinese: 辅助近战攻击技能，使该技能在使用时自动重复三次，每次以一个随机的敌人为目标。无法辅助瓦尔技能、持续吟唱技能、旅行技能、反击技能或触发类技能。
english: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat three times when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.

chinese: 辅助近战攻击技能，使该技能在使用时自动重复两次，每次以一个随机的敌人为目标。无法辅助瓦尔技能、持续吟唱技能、旅行技能、反击技能或触发类技能。
english: Supports melee attack skills, making them repeat twice when used, targeting a random enemy each time. Cannot support Vaal skills, channelling skills, travel skills, retaliation skills or triggered skills.

chinese: 辅助近战攻击技能。
english: Supports melee attack skills.

chinese: 辅助近战攻击技能。无法辅助召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.

chinese: 辅助近战攻击技能，无法辅助触发攻击技能、除你之外的生物使用的攻击技能，或能够召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions.

chinese: 辅助近战攻击技能。召唤生物无法获得怒火。
english: Supports melee attack skills. Minions cannot gain rage.

chinese: 辅助你亲自使用的近战攻击。无法影响召唤生物使用的技能。
english: Supports melee attacks you use yourself. Does not modify skills used by minions.

chinese: 辅助近战打击技能，无法影响召唤生物使用的技能。
english: Supports melee attacks. Does not modify skills used by minions.

chinese: 辅助近战打击技能和猛击技能。被辅助技能每次施展第三次的时候都会施放强力一击.
english: Supports melee strike or slam skills. Every third time you use a supported attack, that use of the skill will be more powerful.

chinese: 辅助本身不会施加内伤的近战打击技能。不能辅助触发类技能、瓦尔技能或除你之外的生物使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports melee strike skills that do not inherently apply Trauma. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助近战打击技能，在每个击中的目标周围造成溅射伤害。
english: Supports melee strike skills, causing their melee strike to deal splash damage around each target hit.

chinese: 辅助近战打击技能，使该技能可以同时打击额外的目标，额外目标和使用者之间必须保持最小距离。如果用来辅助召唤生物的攻击技能，则该召唤生物不会获得额外打击目标。无法辅助瓦尔技能或触发技能。
english: Supports melee strike skills, causing them to also strike at extra targets simultaneously. The extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user. If supporting a minion attack skill, the minion's skills will not also strike extra targets. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills.

chinese: 辅助非光环魔蛊诅咒技能。
english: Supports non-aura hex curse skills.

chinese: 辅助非祝福法术。
english: Supports non-blessing spells.

chinese: 辅助非瞬发法术技能。
english: Supports non-instant spell skills.

chinese: 辅助由你亲自施放的奉献技能。
english: Supports offering skills you use yourself.

chinese: 辅助使用弓类或法杖的投射物攻击技能。不能辅助触发技能、吟唱技能或召唤生物技能。
english: Supports projectile attack skills that use bows or wands. Cannot support triggered skills, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

chinese: 辅助投射物攻击技能。
english: Supports projectile attack skills.

chinese: 辅助投射物和其他任意能连锁的技能。
english: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

chinese: 辅助投射物技能，使该技能的投射物在首次击中敌人时不再穿透并分叉成 2 个。
english: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first time they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

chinese: 辅助投射物技能，使它们的投射物在头两次击中敌人且未穿透时，分裂为两个。
english: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

chinese: 辅助投射物技能。
english: Supports projectile skills.

chinese: 辅助你自身施放的投射物法术。无法辅助触发类技能、瓦尔技能、瞬发技能、持续吟唱技能，有保留效果或产生召唤生物技能，以及图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。
english: Supports projectile spells you cast yourself. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, instant skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation or which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

chinese: 辅助向上发射投射物的远程攻击技能。无法辅助触发类攻击、非你亲自使用的攻击，或创造召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports ranged attack skills that fire projectiles upwards. Cannot support triggered attacks, attacks used by things other than you, or skills which create minions.

chinese: 辅助反击技能。
english: Supports retaliation skills.

chinese: 辅助可以击中敌人或召唤生物的技能。当该技能或召唤生物击败敌人，或击中稀有或传奇敌人时，有一定几率召唤一个幻灵，该生物可以使用穿刺投射物法术造成物理伤害。
english: Supports skills that can hit enemies, or create minions. When those skills or minions kill enemies, or hit rare or unique enemies they will have a chance to summon a Phantasm minion, which uses a piercing projectile spell that deals physical damage.

chinese: 辅助可创造可被伤害的召唤生物的技能。无法辅助触发类技能。
english: Supports skills that create minions which can be damaged. Cannot support triggered skills.

chinese: 辅助召唤生物技能。
english: Supports skills that create minions.

chinese: 辅助可创造哨兵召唤生物的技能，使这些召唤物被创造时获得圣堂光环增益效果。
english: Supports skills that create sentinel minions, causing those minions to be created with a beneficial templar aura.

chinese: 辅助玩家自身射出投射物的技能。不会影响其他来源或二次产生的投射物。无法辅助螺旋发射投射物的技能。
english: Supports skills that fire projectiles from the user. Does not affect projectiles fired from other locations as secondary effects. Does not support skills that fire projectiles in a spiral.

chinese: 辅助有冷却时间的技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports skills that have a cooldown. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助击中敌人的技能，使其在你具有所有三种元素共振时获得加成，击中时除了造成最高伤害的那一个之外，给予其它元素的共振效果。每种元素的共振效果最多 50 层。不能辅助触发技能、瞬发技能、法球技能、烙印技能、有保留效果的技能，或图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports skills that hit enemies, causing them to gain bonuses while you have resonance of all three elements, and to grant resonance of elements other than the highest one in a hit. There is a maximum of 50 Resonance for each Element. Cannot support triggered skills, instant skills, orb skills, brands, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助可击中敌人的技能。当你拥有闪电、物理与混沌的罪恶共鸣时，使技能获得加成；并且在一次击中，如果某伤害类型的数值并非最高，则其每次击中会为你提供该伤害类型的罪恶共鸣。每种伤害类型的罪恶共鸣最多 50 层。无法辅助触发类技能、瞬发技能、法球技能、烙印技能、带保留效果的技能，或由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports skills that hit enemies, causing them to gain bonuses while you have unholy resonance of lightning, physical and chaos, and to grant unholy resonance of damage types other than the highest one in a hit. There is a maximum of 50 unholy resonance for each damage type. Cannot support triggered skills, instant skills, orb skills, brands, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助能击中敌人的技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports skills that hit enemies. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助召唤弩炮图腾的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports skills that summon ballista totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助创造召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports skills which create Minions.

chinese: 辅助产生烙印的技能。
english: Supports skills which create brands.

chinese: 辅助召唤图腾的技能。
english: Supports skills which summon totems.

chinese: 辅助召唤图腾的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports skills which summon totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助陷阱或地雷技能。
english: Supports skills which throw Traps or Mines.

chinese: 辅助地雷技能。
english: Supports skills which throw mines.

chinese: 辅助陷阱技能。
english: Supports skills which throw traps.

chinese:
辅助有冷却时间的技能。
无法辅助触发技能。
english:
Supports skills with cooldowns.
Cannot support triggered skills.

chinese: 辅助你亲自施放的猛击技能，使其在击中地面时创造出裂隙。
english: Supports slam skills you use yourself, causing them to create fissures when impacting the ground.

chinese: 辅助猛击技能，使其召唤出一个先祖图腾，在你靠近图腾的时候为你使用技能。靠近图腾还可以为你提高近战技能的效果区域。
english: Supports slam skills, causing them to summon an ancestor totem that uses the skill for you while you're near it. Being near it grants you increased area of effect for melee skills.

chinese: 辅助猛击技能，使它们在使用时得到强力加持，在下一次得到加持前有一定延迟。不能辅助瓦尔技能或触发技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。只有你自己施放的技能可以得到加持。
english: Supports slam skills, providing a powerful boost when they're used, with a delay before they can be boosted again. Cannot support Vaal skills or triggered skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Only skills you use yourself can receive the boost.

chinese: 辅助对目标位置造成范围效果的法术技能。无法辅助瓦尔技能、图腾，陷阱和地雷使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助瞬发且没有保留效果的法术技能。无法辅助瓦尔技能，或由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports spell skills that are instant and have no reservation. Cannot support Vaal skills or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助非触发类法术技能，你将不再直接施放被辅助的法术，而是召唤一个图腾为你施放该法术。
english: Supports spell skills that are not triggered. Instead of casting that spell, you will summon a totem that casts the spell for you.

chinese: 辅助造成击中伤害且无保留效果的法术技能。无法辅助奥术技能、烙印技能、法球技能、瓦尔技能，以及由图腾、陷阱或地雷使用的技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports spell skills that deal damage with hits and have no reservation. Cannot support arcane skills, Brand skills, Orb skills, Vaal skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助没有保留效果的法术技能。无法辅助由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports spell skills that have no reservation. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助可以击中敌人且没有保留效果的法术技能。不能辅助烙印技能、法球技能、吟唱技能、秘术技能、瓦尔技能或地雷和陷阱使用的技能。不能调整召唤生物技能。
english: Supports spell skills that hit enemies and have no reservation. Cannot support brand skills, orb skills, channelling skills, arcane skills, Vaal skills or skills used by traps or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助击中敌人的法术技能。无法作用于召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports spell skills that hit enemies. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助你自身施放的法术。无法辅助触发类技能、瓦尔技能、瞬发技能、持续吟唱技能，有保留效果或产生召唤生物技能，以及图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。
english: Supports spell skills that you cast yourself. Cannot support triggered skills, Vaal skills, instant skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation or which create minions, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

chinese: 辅助法术技能，使其由直觉链接触发。无法辅助由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。瓦尔技能、引导技能和有保留效果的技能无法被触发。
english: Supports spell skills, causing them to be triggered by Intuitive Link. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

chinese: 辅助法术技能，使其被触发。无法辅助由图腾、陷阱、地雷使用的技能。瓦尔技能、引导技能和有保留效果的技能无法被触发。
english: Supports spell skills, causing them to be triggered. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

chinese: 辅助法术技能，使力量属性也会像提高近战物理伤害一样提高法术伤害。
english: Supports spell skills, making the increase to physical melee damage from strength also increase their spell damage.

chinese: 辅助法术类技能，使其在施放时效果可以重复。无法辅助具有冷却时间的技能、触发类技能、烙印技能、瓦尔技能、持续吟唱技能、有保留效果的技能，或图腾、陷阱和地雷使用的技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports spell skills, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered skills, Brand skills, Vaal skills, channelling skills, skills with a reservation, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助法术技能，使其施放时重复一次。无法辅助瓦尔技能、图腾技能、烙印技能、持续吟唱技能、触发技能、瞬发技能、反击技能、闪现技能或有保留效果的技能。
english: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, brand skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

chinese: 辅助法术技能，使其施放时自动重复一次。无法辅助瓦尔技能、图腾技能、持续吟唱技能、触发技能、瞬发技能、反击技能、闪现技能或有保留效果的技能。
english: Supports spell skills, making them repeat when cast. Cannot support Vaal skills, totem skills, channelling skills, triggered skills, instant skills, retaliation skills, blink skills, or skills with a reservation.

chinese: 辅助可获得法术凝聚的法术技能。
english: Supports spells skills that gain Intensity.

chinese: 辅助可以击中敌人的法术技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports spells that hit enemies. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助法术技能，或使用弓类或法杖的攻击技能。你不再使用被辅助的技能，而是投掷地雷，当你将地雷引爆时为你使用该技能。地雷无法使用吟唱技能。
english: Supports spells, or attacks that use bows or wands. Instead of using that skill, you will throw a mine that will use the skill for you when you detonate it. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

chinese: 辅助法术技能，或使用弓类或法杖的攻击技能。你不再使用被辅助的技能，而是投掷陷阱，当一个敌人接近时为你使用该技能。陷阱无法使用吟唱技能。
english: Supports spells, or attacks that use bows or wands. Instead of using that skill, you will throw a trap that will use the skill for you when an enemy walks near it. Traps cannot use channelling skills.

chinese: 辅助打击技能。
english: Supports strike skills.

chinese: 辅助陷阱技能，使该技能在一条线上扔出额外陷阱。
english: Supports traps skills, making them throw extra traps in a line.

chinese: 辅助陷阱技能，使该技能在目标周围随机扔出额外陷阱。
english: Supports traps skills, making them throw extra traps randomly around the targeted location.

chinese: 辅助由你亲自施放的战吼技能。
english: Supports warcry skills you use yourself.

chinese: 辅助战吼技能。
english: Supports warcry skills.

chinese: 辅助战吼技能。无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports warcry skills. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 辅助战吼技能。无法辅助反击技能，也无法影响召唤生物的技能。
english: Supports warcry skills. Cannot support retaliation skills or modify the skills of minions.

chinese: 被压制的法术伤害对你特别不幸
english: Suppressed Spell Damage dealt to you is Unlucky

chinese: 斯瓦林：格挡时施放
english: Svalinn Cast on Block

chinese: 极速腐化(辅)
english: Swift Affliction

chinese: 迅整（辅）
english: Swift Assembly

chinese: 迅猛烙印（辅）
english: Swiftbrand

chinese: 每失去一层动量，迅捷使移动速度加快 15%
english: Swiftness grants 15% increased Movement Speed per Momentum lost

chinese: 挥舞斧类或剑类，消耗【钢刃碎片】，产生一个保护你一段时间的钢刃结界。它会发射投射物，并在撞击或发射后不久粉碎，对前方敌人造成范围伤害。钢刃碎片由【钢铁呼唤】技能提供。
english: Swing an Axe or Sword, consuming Steel Shards to gain a Steel Ward that protects you for a duration, and fire projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

chinese: 挥舞斧类或剑类并发射投射物，在撞击或发射后不久粉碎，对前方敌人造成范围伤害。
english: Swing an Axe or Sword, firing projectiles which shatter on impact or soon after being launched, dealing area damage in front of where they shatter.

chinese: 挥动法杖在前方大范围内降下多个投射物，可直接锁定区域内敌人的位置。所有投射物在落地前会显示预判落点标记，触地时爆炸造成范围伤害，并触发动能异变技能。此技能无法被陷阱、地雷或图腾使用。
english: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage and triggering Kinetic Anomaly. Cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 挥动法杖在前方大范围内降下多发投射物，直接锁定区域内敌人的位置。所有投射物在落地前会显示预判落点标记，触地时爆炸造成范围伤害。
english: Swing your wand to cause a number of projectiles to rain down within a large area in front of you, directly targeting the locations of enemies in the area. The locations where each projectile will land are shown with markers before they fall. Each projectile explodes when hitting the ground, dealing area damage.

chinese: 用双手锤或长杖画圈挥舞，召唤神圣之锤随机落在被击中的数个敌人身上。这些神圣之锤造成的击中无法被闪避。
english: Swings a two handed mace or a staff in a circle, calling down holy hammers to land randomly on a number of enemies struck. Hits from these holy hammers cannot be evaded.

chinese: 用双手锤或长杖画圈挥舞，在一段时间内持续召唤神圣之锤波浪。无法被多重打击辅助。
english: Swings a two handed mace or a staff in a circle, calling down waves of holy hammers for a duration. Cannot be supported by Multistrike.

chinese: 挥舞盾牌，朝你面前造成三道范围伤害的冲击波。敌人可以被两道交叠的冲击波伤害。
english: Swipe your shield, dealing area damage in three waves in front of you. Enemies can be hit by two of the waves where they overlap.

chinese: 落刃风暴
english: Swordstorm

chinese: 受到相当于生命上限 40% 和能量护盾上限 25% 的混沌伤害
english: Take 40% of maximum Life and 25% of maximum Energy Shield as Chaos Damage

chinese: 受到相当于能量护盾上限 50% 的混沌伤害
english: Take 50% of maximum Energy Shield as Chaos Damage

chinese: 短期内受到的物理伤害和元素伤害降低。最多消耗 5 个耐力球使增益效果持续更久，并进一步降低受到的物理伤害。和防卫技能共用冷却时间。
english: Take less Physical and Elemental Damage for a short time. Consumes up to 5 Endurance Charges to lengthen the buff and further lessen Physical Damage taken. Shares a cooldown with other Guard skills.

chinese:
将你与周围友军受到的元素伤害转化为回复生命
你与周围友军无法获得瓦尔之灵
english:
Taking Elemental Damage instead heals you and Nearby Allies
You and Nearby Allies cannot gain Vaal Souls

chinese: 对一个灵柩施法，使其周围目标都受到一个法术伤害。同时使该灵柩爆炸， 对附近的敌人造成火焰伤害。爆炸造成的伤害无法被法术伤害词缀加成，并且无法被反射。
english: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected.

chinese: 对一个灵柩施法，使其周围目标都受到一个法术伤害。同时使该灵柩爆炸，对附近的敌人造成火焰伤害。爆炸造成的伤害无法被法术伤害词缀加成，并且无法被反射。爆炸会继续指定区域内的其他灵柩，每个灵柩之间的爆炸间隔较短，直到灵柩消耗殆尽或有 8 个灵柩被引爆。无法被多重范围施法辅助。
english: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with a shorter delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 8 corpses. Cannot be supported by Spell Cascade.

chinese: 对一个灵柩施法，使其周围目标都受到一个法术伤害。同时使该灵柩爆炸， 对附近的敌人造成火焰伤害。爆炸造成的伤害无法被法术伤害词缀加成，并且无法被反射。爆炸会继续指定区域内的其他灵柩，每个灵柩之间的爆炸间隔持续延长，直到灵柩消耗殆尽或有 22 个灵柩被引爆。
english: Targets a corpse, and deals spell damage to enemies around the corpse, as well as causing the corpse to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. This will continue to target other corpses in the area, with an increasing delay between each one, until it runs out of corpses or has destroyed 22 corpses.

chinese: 对一个灵柩施法并使其爆炸，造成火焰伤害。爆炸造成的伤害无法被法术伤害词缀加成，并且无法被反射。无法选择由技能创造的灵柩。
english: Targets a corpse, causing it to explode, dealing fire damage. The explosion is not affected by modifiers to spell damage and cannot be reflected. Cannot target corpses that have been created by skills.

chinese: 同一名友方玩家产生羁绊并持续一段时间。在羁绊期间，羁绊对象可以触发你辅助的法术。若羁绊对象在此期间被击败，你也会同时被击败。该技能不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷施放，也不能被触发。
english: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, their hits can trigger your supported spells. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 同一名友方玩家产生羁绊并持续一段时间。在羁绊期间，羁绊对象会复制你的格挡率，并在格挡时回复生命。若羁绊对象在此期间被击败，你也会同时被击败。该技能不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷施放，也不能被触发。
english: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they copy your block chance and recover life when they block. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 同一名友方玩家产生羁绊并持续一段时间。在羁绊期间，羁绊对象按照你的生命造成额外火焰伤害。若羁绊对象在此期间被击败，你也会同时被击败。该技能不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷施放，也不能被触发。
english: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 同一名友方玩家产生羁绊并持续一段时间。在羁绊期间，你的生命偷取改为给羁绊对象恢复生命。若羁绊对象在此期间被击败，你也会同时被击败。该技能不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷施放，也不能被触发。
english: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they get recovery from your life leech instead of you. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 同一名友方玩家产生羁绊并持续一段时间。在羁绊期间，羁绊对象可以使用你的主手暴击率。若羁绊对象在此期间被击败，你也会同时被击败。该技能不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷施放，也不能被触发。
english: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your main hand critical strike chance. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 同一名友方玩家产生羁绊并持续一段时间。在羁绊期间，你的能量护盾可以为羁绊对象阻挡一部分伤害。若羁绊对象在此期间被击败，你也会同时被击败。该技能不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷施放，也不能被触发。
english: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 指定一片区域，根据施法速度在其中叠加层数。每 3 层爆炸一次，最多叠满 15 层。层数叠加期间，范围会逐渐缩小，但伤害会逐渐提高。
english: Targets an area and builds up stages in that area based on cast speed. It explodes every 3 stages, until it reaches a maximum of 15. As it gains more stages, the area gets smaller but the damage gets higher.

english: Tawhoa's Chosen

english: Tears of Rot

chinese: 破釜一击
english: Tectonic Slam

chinese: 灾变之破釜一击

chinese: 传送到指定地点，对敌人造成伤害，并在传送开始位置和结束位置留下冰缓地面。和其它闪现技能共用冷却时间。
english: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving Chilled ground in an area at both ends of the teleport. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

chinese: 传送到指定地点，对敌人造成伤害并在路线上留下燃烧地面。随后朝相反方向重复传送。无法被触发，无法被图腾、陷阱或地雷使用。无法被释出辅助。
english: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground, then repeat the teleport in the other direction. Cannot be triggered, or used by a totem, trap or mine. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

chinese: 传送到指定地点，对敌人造成伤害并在路线上留下燃烧地面。和其它闪现技能共用冷却时间。
english: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies and leaving a trail of burning ground. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

chinese: 传送到指定地点，对传送开始位置和结束位置的敌人造成伤害。对冰缓的敌人造成更高的伤害，随后移除其冰缓效果。无法被释出辅助。
english: Teleport to a location, damaging enemies in an area at both ends of the teleport. Deals higher damage to chilled enemies, then removes chill from them. Cannot be supported by Unleash.

chinese: 传送至指定目的地. 起点跟终点产生一圈冰缓地面.
english: Teleport to a target destination. Chilled ground is spread in an area around both where the caster was and where they teleported to.

chinese: 若你在过去 0.5 秒内尚未引爆符纹，则传送至被引爆的符纹处
english: Teleport to the detonated Rune if you have not detonated Runes in the past 0.5 seconds

chinese: 传送至目标怪物身边并用近战武器对其造成伤害。若是未选定目标，则系统会为其随机指定一只怪物。获得一个增益效果，使移动速度提高一段时间。消耗一个狂怒球能重置其技能冷却。
english: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge.

chinese: 传送至目标怪物身边并用近战武器对其造成伤害。若是未选定目标，则系统会为其随机指定一只怪物。获得一个增益效果，使移动速度提高一段时间。消耗一个暴击球能重置其技能冷却。
english: Teleports the character to a nearby monster and attacks with a melee weapon. If no specific monster is targeted, one is picked at random. Grants a buff that increases movement speed for a duration. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Power Charge.

chinese: 将你传送到敌人周围，并在短时间内施加一个增益效果。施展近战攻击会移除该增益效果，并增助这次攻击。
english: Teleports you to a nearby enemy, applying a buff to you for a short duration and blinding the enemy for a secondary duration. Performing a melee attack with a One-Handed Weapon removes the buff to exert that attack.

chinese: 暴风之盾
english: Tempest Shield

chinese: 时空锁链
english: Temporal Chains

chinese: 时空裂隙
english: Temporal Rift

chinese: 藤蔓抽击
english: Tentacle Whip

chinese: 在身体前方以弧状同时挥动两把武器，对前方区域的怪物造成伤害。需要双持一把斧类与一把剑类武器。
english: The character swings both their weapons in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Requires dual wielding both an Axe and a Sword.

chinese: 在身体前方以弧状挥动武器（双持时则挥动两把武器），对前方区域的怪物造成伤害。消灭一个稀有或传奇敌人会给你一个增益，在一段时间内强化劈砍。消灭一个稀有敌人还能够在一段时间内窃取其词缀。限定斧类与剑类。
english: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Killing Blows on Rare or Unique enemies grant a buff that improves Cleave for a duration. Killing Blows on Rare Enemies also steal their modifiers for a secondary duration. Only works with Axes and Swords.

chinese: 在身体前方以弧状挥动武器（双持时则挥动两把武器）, 对前方区域的怪物造成伤害。限定斧类与剑类。
english: The character swings their weapon (or both weapons if dual wielding) in an arc, damaging monsters in an area in front of them. Only works with Axes and Swords.

chinese: 角色以拳头敲击前方的地面, 攻速较慢, 伤害较高. 该攻击能对大范围内的敌人造成闪电伤害, 并有几率对其造成感电效果. 持有武器时无法使用.
english: The character uses their fist to slam the ground in front of them, with less attack speed, but more damage. This attack deals Lightning Damage to enemies in a large area, with a chance to Shock them. Cannot be used while wielding a Weapon. Cannot be Evaded.

chinese: 首次与最终射击同时额外发射 10 个投射物
english: The first and final shots of the sequence fire 10 additional Projectiles simultaneously

chinese: 制造 3 条巨大的藤蔓砸向地面造成一定范围内的武器伤害。每条藤蔓造成一定范围的攻击伤害。
english: This attack causes three otherworldly tentacles to strike the ground around you, each dealing your attack damage in an area.

chinese: 从被击中的敌人周围发射一圈寒冰投射物，并将造成的所有物理伤害转化为冰霜伤害。
english: This attack fires icy projectiles in a circle around enemies you hit, dealing attack damage with all physical damage converted to cold.

chinese: 召唤一个你所使用的武器的复制体来攻击敌人。此技能有短暂冷却时间。
english: This attack is performed repeatedly by a ghostly imitation of your weapon.

chinese: 此攻击由你的雕像使用，在其向前移动的同时对它们周围区域造成伤害。该技能无法重复，且只能由冰封军团召唤的雕像使用。
english: This attack is used by your Statues to deal damage in an area around them while stepping forward. This skill cannot repeat and can only be used by Statues from Frozen Legion.

chinese: 此技能暂时被停用，目前无法使用。
english: This skill is temporarily disabled and cannot be used.

chinese: 该技能由被辅助技能触发，召唤圣洁鬼灵，在你使用技能时使用触发技能。
english: This skill is triggered by supported skills to summon Sacred Wisps which use the triggering skill when you do.

chinese: 你使用猛击或打击技能时会触发该技能，召唤一个蜃影酋长，它在消失前会使用一次猛击或打击技能。
english: This skill is triggered when you use a Slam or Strike skill, and summons a Mirage Chieftain who will use that Slam or Strike skill once before dissipating.

chinese: 此法术会使你已有的一个统御哨兵将获得飞升 使其变得更加强大并获得新的技能，同时覆盖该哨兵的持续时间，并保留它的相关加成（包括来自宝石的加成）。如果你已经无法拥更多飞升的统御哨兵，那么已有的飞升哨兵将会被刷新。
english: This spell causes one of your existing Sentinels of Dominance to Ascend, becoming more powerful, gaining new attacks, and overriding its duration, while maintaining its monster modifiers and other bonuses, including from support gems. If you cannot have more Ascended Sentinels of Dominance, an existing one will be refreshed instead.

chinese: 此法术消耗多个冷却时间次数来召唤一圈寒冰雕像。每个雕像都会在消失前使用你的冰封横扫攻击。需要斧类、锤类、短杖或长杖。该技能不能由图腾、陷阱、地雷施放，也不能被触发或受“施法回响”和“释出”辅助。
english: This spell consumes multiple cooldown uses to summon icy Statues in a ring. Each Statue uses your Frozen Sweep attack once before vanishing. Requires an Axe, Mace, Sceptre, or Staff. This skill cannot be triggered, supported by Spell Echo or Unleash, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

chinese: 在你的四周召唤出一群虚空的刀刃，以你为中心短暂地飞舞旋转，刀刃每隔 0.6 秒对周围敌人造成一次伤害。
english: This spell creates a swarm of ethereal blades which briefly orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius.

chinese: 在你的四周召唤出虚空的刀刃, 以你为中心不断飞舞旋转, 刀刃每隔0.6秒对周围敌人造成一次伤害. 随着刀刃的增加, 伤害也会增加.
english: This spell creates ethereal blades which orbit in an area around you, dealing damage every 0.6 seconds to all enemies in their radius. As more blades are added, the damage becomes greater and more frequent.

chinese: 在你周围的一个区域造成混沌伤害。施放这个法术会使你获得摧灭。当你获得了 7 层摧灭时，牺牲大量生命值，造成基于牺牲量的额外混沌伤害，并移除你所有的摧灭。
english: This spell deals chaos damage in an area around you. Casting this spell will cause you to gain Ruin. If this spell inflicts your seventh Ruin, it will sacrifice a large portion of your life to deal extra chaos damage based on the amount sacrificed, and remove all Ruin from you.

chinese: 该法术会消耗一个你或光标附近魔侍的部分生命值来对其周围造成混沌伤害. 该效果会连锁到你在附近的其他魔侍. 如果你或光标附近已没有魔侍, 则会牺牲你自己的部分生命来造成混沌伤害.
english: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead.

chinese: 双持时最多额外投掷 1 个陷阱

chinese: 向范围内的最多 8 个目标投掷锁链

chinese: 投掷一个爆炸瓶，在一片区域内造成徒手攻击伤害，并有几率使敌人中毒。可以消耗生命药剂的充能来进一步增加伤害。需要空出主手，且没有持握副手武器。
english: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area and has a chance to poison. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

chinese: 投掷一个爆炸瓶，在一片区域内造成徒手攻击伤害。可以消耗红玉药剂、黄玉药剂、蓝玉药剂的充能来进一步增加伤害。需要空出主手，也不能持握副手武器。
english: Throws a bottle that explodes to deal unarmed attack damage in an area. Can consume charges from your Ruby, Sapphire, and Topaz flasks to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

chinese: 投掷一个地雷，引爆时对一片区域造成伤害，然后发射火焰投射物，在其周围像雨点一样散落，每颗投射物都会小范围的爆炸。放置在地上的地雷，会对其范围内的敌人施加火焰曝露效果。
english: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated, then launches fiery projectiles that rain down around it, each exploding to deal damage in a smaller area. Placed mines apply a fire exposure aura to nearby enemies.

chinese: 投掷一个地雷，引爆时对一片区域造成伤害。
english: Throws a mine that deals damage in an area when detonated.

chinese: 投掷一个地雷，引爆时向周围发射投射物，在飞行途中快速挥发，并很快消失。
english: Throws a mine that fires projectiles around it when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

chinese: 投掷一个地雷，引爆时向敌人发射投射物，在飞行途中快速消散，并很快消失。
english: Throws a mine that fires projectiles at enemies when detonated. These projectiles quickly dissipate as they travel, before disappearing.

chinese: 投掷一个地雷，当它引爆时将你传送至该地雷所在处。当传送时，在原本位置与地雷所在位置的区块都会被充满烟雾，致盲其中的敌人，并给你一个提高移动速度的临时增益效果。和其它闪现技能共用冷却时间。
english: Throws a mine that will teleport you to it when detonated. It covers both your escape and arrival with a cloud of smoke that blinds enemies, and gives you a temporary buff to movement speed. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills.

chinese: 投掷一个爆炸瓶，击中地面时爆发，在一片区域内造成徒手攻击伤害，并有几率使敌人中毒。该技能可以连锁，多次随机弹跳并造成伤害。可以消耗生命药剂的充能来进一步增加伤害。需要空出主手，且没有持握副手武器。
english: Throws a single bottle that releases a burst when it hits the ground, dealing unarmed attack damage in an area with a chance to poison. The skill chains, bouncing randomly to deal damage multiple times. Can consume charges from a Life flask to add further damage. Requires an empty main hand, and no off-hand weapon.

chinese: 复制手中的近战武器，并将此灵体投掷出去。此灵体将会向外飞出并如同回力镖一般回到你的身边，对所有碰触到的敌人造成伤害。
english: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then returns to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in its path.

chinese: 复制一把手中的近战武器并投掷出去。它会盘旋飞出，形成一个巨大的螺旋，对路径上所有敌人造成伤害。如果碰到墙壁会回弹。
english: Throws a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls.

chinese: 使用念能力复制副手上的盾并且掷出穿刺投射物，造成盾牌防御属性强化的副手伤害。抵达目标位置时悬停在原地，向各个方向重复发射一定数量的小型碎片投射物。碎片发射速度不断加快，直到碎片发射完毕。影响投射物数量的词缀碎会增加碎片的数量，但不会增加投掷盾的数量。
english: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a piercing projectile which deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it reaches the targeted location it will hover in place, repeatedly firing a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. The rate at which it releases shards will increase until all shards have been fired. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

chinese: 使用念能力复制副手上的盾并且掷出制造出根据盾防御属性的副手伤害。该投射物无法穿透敌人，当击中敌人时，该投射物会碎裂，制造出射向各方的小的碎片投射物。影响投射物数量的词缀会增加碎片的数量，但不会增加投掷盾的数量。
english: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the defences of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

chinese: 使用念能力复制副手上的盾并且掷出，根据盾的闪避值属性造成副手伤害。该投射物无法穿透敌人，当击中敌人时，该投射物会碎裂，制造出射向各方的小的碎片投射物。影响投射物数量的词缀会增加碎片的数量，但不会增加投掷盾的数量。
english: Throws a spectral copy of your shield as a projectile which cannot pierce, and deals off-hand damage augmented by the evasion of the shield. When it collides with something it will shatter, launching a number of smaller shards as projectiles in all directions. Modifiers that cause additional projectiles to be fired will add more shards, not more copies of the shield.

chinese: 投掷陷阱，在一定时间内对周围一定数量的敌人发射带有减益效果的光线。光线会冰缓敌人，并造成持续性冰霜伤害。
english: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time.

chinese: 投掷陷阱，在一定时间内对周围一定数量的敌人发射带有减益效果的光线。光线会冰缓敌人，并造成持续性冰霜伤害。光线也会基于被其射中的敌人数量，来使你获得一定额度的生命和魔力再生。
english: Throws a trap that applies debuff beams to a number of nearby enemies for a duration. The beams chill enemies and deal cold damage over time. A beam is also applied to you, granting life and mana regeneration based on the number of debuff beams affecting enemies.

chinese: 投掷陷阱，触发后造成一场大爆炸，在周围区域内造成法术伤害。
english: Throws a trap that creates a large explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it.

chinese: 抛出一个触发时在其周围制造一圈冰霜印记爆破的陷阱，对所有在爆破范围内的敌人造成冰霜伤害。
english: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions in a circle around itself when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.

chinese: 抛出一个触发时会制造一连串冰霜印记爆破的陷阱, 对所有在爆破范围内的敌人造成冰霜伤害.
english: Throws a trap that creates a series of icy runic explosions when triggered, dealing cold damage to all enemies caught in the blasts.

chinese: 投掷陷阱，触发后造成一场爆炸，在周围区域内造成法术伤害。第一次爆炸后陷阱周围的次级区域内会连续快速产生多次小爆炸。
english: Throws a trap that creates an explosion when triggered, dealing spell damage in an area around it. A number of smaller explosions occur within a secondary area around the trap in quick succession after the first.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，对单个敌人造成伤害并使其定身，定身时长由造成的伤害决定。定身结束后，敌人将承受一个移动速度降低的减益效果。被该减益影响的敌人承受陷阱和地雷的伤害会提高。法术伤害加成不会影响该技能。
english: Throws a trap that damages and immobilises a single enemy for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. After the immobilise expires, a debuff remains on the enemy for a duration, lowering their movement speed by an amount which lessens over time. The affected enemy will take increased damage from traps and mines until the debuff expires. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，对单个敌人造成伤害、穿刺与定身，定身时长由造成的伤害决定。法术伤害加成不会影响该技能。
english: Throws a trap that damages and impales a single enemy, and immobilises them for a duration based on how much damage was dealt. Modifiers to spell damage do not affect this skill's damage.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱, 该陷阱被触发时会爆炸并对周围的敌人造成火焰伤害, 且该区域的地面会持续燃烧, 踩在上面的敌人会持续受到伤害.
english: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies and leaving an area of burning ground that damages enemies who walk through it.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，该陷阱被触发时会爆炸并对周围的敌人造成火焰伤害。
english: Throws a trap that explodes when triggered, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，该陷阱被敌人触发时向四面环状发射投射物，对该敌人和后续接触到的敌人造成闪电伤害，并同时留下感电地面。
english: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets and leaving a trail of shocked ground.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱, 该陷阱被触发时将会向全方位散射出闪电投射物, 投射物将会对触发及接触到的敌人造成闪电伤害.
english: Throws a trap that launches a ring of projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，该陷阱被触发时将会散射出闪电投射物，投射物将会对触发及接触到的敌人造成闪电伤害。
english: Throws a trap that launches projectiles through the enemy that set it off, dealing lightning damage to them and subsequent targets.

chinese: 投掷陷阱，触发后向不同方向喷射烈焰。烈焰将持续一段时间，并重复造成伤害。
english: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration repeatedly dealing damage.

chinese: 投掷陷阱，触发后向不同方向喷射烈焰。烈焰持续一段时间，会在陷阱周围旋转，并重复造成伤害。对燃烧的敌人造成更多伤害。
english: Throws a trap that releases a number of flames in different directions around it when triggered. The flames last for a duration, rotating around the trap and repeatedly dealing damage. Burning enemies are dealt more damage.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱, 触发该陷阱的敌人将会短暂的转化为你的手下为你而战.
english: Throws a trap that, when triggered by an enemy, converts that enemy to your side for a short duration. Does not affect unique monsters or players.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时发射一个近战武器的灵幻副本。它会盘旋飞出，形成一个巨大的螺旋，对路径上所有敌人造成伤害。如果碰到墙壁会回弹。双持时每个投掷的陷阱会随机使用主手或副手武器。
english: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires a spectral copy of your melee weapon. It spins around while flying in a large spiral, damaging enemies in its path, and bouncing if it collides with walls. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时发射多个近战武器的灵幻副本。它们向四面八方飞出后返回陷阱触发点，以回旋形式攻击并对沿途路径上的敌人造成伤害。双持时每个投掷的陷阱会随机使用主手或副手武器。
english: Throws a trap which, once triggered, fires many spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out in all directions and then return to where the trap triggered, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path. If dual wielding, each Trap thrown will randomly use either the main hand or off hand weapon.

chinese: 投掷陷阱，触发后发射多股冲击波。每股冲击波都会在其行进线路上产生连续的小冲击，最后以一次大冲击结束。
english: Throws a trap which, once triggered, releases a number of waves. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.

chinese: 投掷陷阱，触发后会在一定时间内持续发射冲击波。每股冲击波都会在其行进线路上产生连续的小冲击，最后以一次大冲击结束。
english: Throws a trap which, once triggered, repeatedly releases a number of waves for a duration. Each wave deals damage in a series of small bursts in a line, ending with a larger burst.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时旋转挥舞你装备的两把匕首、爪类或单手剑的副本，反复不断对它范围内的敌人造成伤害。
english: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw or One Handed Sword around it in circles, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时旋转挥舞你装备的两把匕首、爪类、单手剑或单手斧的副本，对它范围内的敌人造成伤害。
english: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Dagger, Claw, One Handed Sword or One Handed Axe around it in a circle, each damaging enemies it spins through.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱，触发时旋转挥舞你装备的两把双手剑的副本，反复不断对它范围内的敌人造成伤害，持续一定时间。
english: Throws a trap which, once triggered, swings two copies of your equipped Two Handed Sword around it in circles for a duration, each repeatedly damaging enemies it spins through

chinese: 投掷陷阱，触发后会在一定时间内连续电击多个区域，并造成闪电伤害。
english: Throws a trap which, once triggered, will repeatedly strike multiple areas around it for a duration, dealing lightning damage.

chinese: 复制手中的近战武器，并将此无形灵体投掷出去。此灵体将会向外飞出，并在归返时化为实体，仅能在返回时击中敌人并造成伤害。
english: Throws an intangible spectral copy of your melee weapon. It flies out and then becomes tangible as it returns to you, in a spinning attack that only hits and damages enemies while returning.

chinese: 向你的前方投掷连锁钩爪，附着在命中的目标上。被束缚的敌人受到攻击时为施法者提供怒火。当锁链断裂时，会在束缚目标周围区域造成攻击伤害。限定单手锤、短杖、剑类或斧类。
english: Throws chains ahead of you, attaching them to targets hit. Enemies chained to you will grant rage when hit. When chains are broken, they snap and deal attack damage in an area around the target they were attached to. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.

chinese: 投掷一个陷阱, 该陷阱会创造一个裂隙，并从异界吸引来一只恶魔之手。当陷阱被触发时，这只手会撕裂裂隙的底部，粉碎现实，在一个区域内造成法术伤害。
english: Throws out a trap which creates a rift, attracting a malefic hand from another realm. When the trap is triggered, the hand tears the bottom of the breach out, shattering reality to deal spell damage in an area.

chinese: 复制数把手中的近战武器，把它们投掷出去。它们飞出后会以回旋形式返回，伤害沿途路径上的敌人。
english: Throws several spectral copies of your melee weapon. They fly out and then return to you, in a spinning attack that damages enemies in their path.

chinese: 向前投掷一把剑或斧头，在前方凝聚一团剑刃。它会依次对前方或靠近它的敌人发射投射物。
english: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it.

chinese: 向前投掷一把剑或斧头，消耗钢刃碎片在前方凝聚一团剑刃。它会依次对前方或靠近它的敌人发射投射物。钢刃碎片由【钢铁呼唤】提供。
english: Thrust an Axe or Sword forward, consuming your Steel Shards to form a cluster of shards in front of you. The cluster will fire a number of projectiles in sequence, aiming at enemies in front of or close to it. Steel Shards are gained with the Call of Steel Skill.

chinese: 发出一束灼热光线，被击中的敌人会受到不断叠加的燃烧效果。每叠加一层效果都会附加一定比例的光线基础伤害。脱离光线范围后的一段时间内依然会受到燃烧伤害。增加施法速度可以加快光线的转角速度。
english: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

chinese: 发出一束灼热光线，被击中的敌人会受到不断叠加的燃烧效果。每叠加一层效果都会附加一定比例的光线基础伤害。叠满之后会造成火焰曝露。脱离光线范围后的一段时间内依然会受到燃烧伤害。增加施法速度可以加快光线的转角速度。
english: Unleash a beam of fire that burns enemies it touches. Remaining in the beam raises the burning, adding a portion of the beam's damage in stages. Inflicts Fire Exposure at maximum stages. Enemies who leave the beam continue to burn for a duration. Increasing cast speed also increases the rate at which the beam turns.

chinese: 在你持续吟唱时，创造多个能量球，并不断跳离目标区域，直到持续时间消失，每一跳都会对小范围内造成伤害。当你停止吟唱，所有剩余的能量球会爆炸，对更大范围造成更高伤害。
english: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump away from the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

chinese: 在你持续吟唱时，创造多个能量球，并不断跳向目标区域，直到持续时间消失，每一跳都会对小范围内造成伤害。当你停止吟唱，所有剩余的能量球会爆炸，对更大范围造成更高伤害。
english: Unleash orbs of energy while you channel that repeatedly jump towards the targeted location until their duration expires, dealing damage in a small area after each jump. When you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode, dealing higher damage in a larger area.

chinese: 释放一颗球型火焰向前飞射, 接触到怪物时会爆炸并对周围敌人造成伤害
english: Unleashes a ball of fire towards a target which explodes, damaging nearby foes.

chinese: 对你的敌人造成持续的混沌伤害。受到瘟疫影响的敌人被击败时，其减益效果将会传染到周边敌人的身上，每次传播造成的伤害为原先的四分之三。
english: Unleashes a vile contagion on enemies, dealing chaos damage over time. If an enemy dies while affected by Contagion, the debuff spreads to other enemies, but each time it spreads, it only deals three quarters as much damage as before.

chinese: 摧毁自己的身体，在选取的敌人或灵柩的位置重生，对一片区域内造成法术伤害。如果没有选取目标，它会优先以灵柩为目标。如果以灵柩为目标，该灵柩会爆炸，对周围造成伤害，该伤害不受法术伤害的词缀影响，也不会被反射。该法术无法重复。
english: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or corpse, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise corpses over enemies. If targeting a corpse, the corpse will also explode, dealing damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.

chinese: 摧毁自己的身体，在选取的敌人或可伤害的召唤生物的位置重生，在起始与目标区域内造成法术伤害。如果没有选取目标，它会优先以召唤生物为目标。如果以召唤生物为目标，该召唤生物会被摧毁并对周围造成伤害，该伤害不受法术伤害的词缀影响，也不会被反射。该法术无法重复。
english: Violently destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or damageable minion, dealing spell damage in an area at both locations. If there is no specific target, it will prioritise minions over enemies. If targeting a minion, the minion will also be destroyed in an explosion which deals damage around it that is not affected by modifiers to spell damage, and cannot be reflected. This spell cannot be repeated.

chinese: 定罪波
english: Wave of Conviction

chinese: 特拉特斯之定罪波
english: Wave of Conviction of Trarthus

chinese: 挥舞法杖创造一枚悬停的动能投射物，短暂延迟后，投射物将自动射向一名敌人，在撞击时造成范围伤害并连锁至更多目标。再次使用此技能将为所有悬停投射物重置持续时间。连续发射的多个投射物会自动选择不同敌人作为目标。无法被陷阱或地雷直接使用。
english: Wave your wand to create a hovering kinetic projectile. After a short duration, the projectile is fired at an enemy, dealing area damage on impact and chaining to further targets. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Multiple projectiles fired in sequence will attempt to target different enemies. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.

chinese: 挥动你的法杖，创造多个悬浮的动能投射物。在短暂延迟后，这些投射物会爆炸，造成范围伤害。再次使用该攻击会重置所有悬浮投射物的持续时间。无法被陷阱或地雷直接使用。
english: Wave your wand to create multiple hovering kinetic projectiles. After a short duration, the projectiles explode, dealing area damage. Using this attack again will reset the duration for all hovering projectiles. Cannot be directly used by traps or mines.

chinese: 引导强化法术结束时，此技能按其引导期间已触发次数再次触发
english:
When Channelling Empowered Spells ends, this Skill Triggers again for every
time it was Triggered while Channelling

chinese: 双持武器时，每把武器联合起来造成 60% 伤害
english: When Dual Wielding, Deals 60% Damage from each Weapon combined

chinese: 双持武器时，每把武器联合起来造成 75% 伤害
english: When Dual Wielding, Deals 75% Damage from each Weapon combined

chinese: 被击中时，释放炽焰复仇新星，对被击中的敌人造成火焰伤害并使其致盲。
english: When hit, release a nova of fiery vengeance, dealing spell fire damage and blinding enemies struck.

chinese: 当你被击中时，释放毒液胆汁新星，造成法术混沌伤害。该新星在命中时会使敌人中毒并造成缓速。
english: When hit, release a nova of venomous bile that deals spell chaos damage. This nova poisons and hinders on hit.

chinese: 远程使用时，会投掷一条锁链，将你拉近被击中的敌人，并对它们身后一片区域内造成伤害。如果贴近敌人使用，则只会直接造成范围伤害。限定单手锤、短杖、剑类或斧类。
english: When used at range, throws out a chain, pulling you to the enemy hit dealing damage in an area behind them. When close to the enemy, just causes the area damage directly. Requires a One Handed Mace, Sceptre, Sword or Axe.

chinese:
当你用被辅助技能发射的箭矢击中敌人时，召唤 1 个会使用此技能的幻影弓手
幻影弓手可以使用触发攻击，并视作没有触发
english:
When you Hit an Enemy with an Arrow from a Supported Skill, Summon a Mirage Archer which uses that Skill
Mirage Archer can use Triggered Attacks as though they were not Triggered

chinese: 使用救世者攻击并造成暴击时，该技能会召唤一个蜃影救世者。召唤的蜃影救世者会使用你在造成暴击时施展的技能。一旦达到他们的召唤上限，你就无法用相同的技能再次召唤他们。
english: When you attack with The Saviour and deal a critical strike, this skill can summon a Mirage Saviour. Summoned Mirage Saviours will fight for you using whichever of your attack skills you dealt the critical strike with that caused them to be summoned. Mirage Saviours will not be resummoned using the same skills if you already have the maximum number of them.

chinese:
孕育时，施加中毒使  40% 
的预计中毒伤害变为瘟疫值
english:
When you inflict Poison while Incubating, adds 40% of the Expected Poison
Damage to Plague Value

english: While Channelling a Supported Skill, take 12% less Damage from Hits

chinese: 持续吟唱被辅助的技能时，受到的击中伤害总降 14%
english: While Channelling a Supported Skill, take 14% less Damage from Hits

english: While Infecting, deals Chaos Damage per second equal to 12% of the Plague Value when Infecting began, and loses Plague Value at the same rate

chinese: 传染时，每秒造成的混沌伤害等于传染开始时瘟疫值的 16%，并以相同倍率失去瘟疫值
english: While Infecting, deals Chaos Damage per second equal to 16% of the Plague Value when Infecting began, and loses Plague Value at the same rate

chinese: 当生效时，依次轮流赋予玩家鸟之力量和鸟之斗魄。鸟之力量会让你和你的召唤生物被击中后短时间内有一定几率造成双倍伤害。鸟之斗魄会让你和你的召唤生物移动速度增加。
english: While active, grants the Avian's Might and Avian's Flight buffs in sequence. Avian's Might grants you and your minions a chance to deal Double Damage with hits for a duration. Avian's Flight grants you and your minions increased Movement Speed for a secondary duration.

chinese: 当生效时，依次轮流赋予玩家猫之隐匿和猫之敏捷。猫之隐匿会提高暴击率，短时间内有一定几率避免伤害，并使你更难被敌人发现。猫之敏捷会在一段时间内增加你的攻击和施法速度。
english: While active, grants the Cat's Stealth and Cat's Agility buffs in sequence. Cat's Stealth increases your critical strike chance, makes you harder to see, and gives you a chance to avoid damage for a short duration. Cat's Agility increases your attack and cast speed for a longer secondary duration.

chinese: 当生效时，每隔一段时间获得深海屏障，每个深海屏障使你获得额外物理伤害减免。所有的深海屏障会在你受到物理伤害时失去。
english: While active, periodically adds Crab Barriers to you, and grants additional Physical Damage reduction for each Crab Barrier you have. All Crab Barriers are lost when you take physical damage from a hit.

chinese: 当生效时，每隔一段时间对周围敌人施加蜘蛛网减益效果，并减缓他们的移动速度。每层敌人身上的蜘蛛网会增加他们受到的伤害。
english: While active, periodically applies a Spider's Web debuff to nearby Enemies, and Hinders them. Each Spider's Web on an Enemy increases the Damage they take. Hinder reduces their movement speed.

chinese: 在激活状态下，此技能使你用弓类攻击击中穿刺的敌人时施加漆黑鸣泣减益效果。漆黑鸣泣造成持续物理伤害，最多可叠加至 5 层。此技能无法由图腾施放。
english: While active, this skill inflicts the Weeping Black debuff on impaled enemies you hit with bow attacks. Weeping Black deals physical damage over time, and can stack up to five times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

chinese: 在激活状态下，你的弓类攻击施加灰烬余火。灰烬余火造成持续火焰伤害，最多可叠加至 10 层。此技能无法由图腾施放。
english: While active, your bow attacks inflict Cinderflame. Cinderflame deals fire damage over time, and can stack up to ten times. This skill cannot be cast by Totems.

chinese: 必须在近战战斗中积累胆魄才能使用该技能，消耗所有胆魄，放置一面具有光环的旗帜。消耗的胆魄越多，光环的范围越大、效果越强。旗帜持续一段时间，当你离开光环范围，或在激活期间再次使用该技能，旗帜就会提前结束。
english: You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active.

english: You take 4% of your Maximum Life per second as Physical Damage

chinese: 你受到的击中伤害降低 90%，并视作冻结
english: You take 90% less Damage from Hits and count as Frozen

chinese: 你保留魔力的非祝福技能在你身上有辅助技能的光环时被禁用
english: Your Non-Blessing Skills which Reserve Mana are Disabled while you have an Aura from a Supported Skill on you

chinese: 你与周围友军不会因为承受伤害而延迟能量护盾回复的间隔时间
english: Your and nearby allies' Energy Shield Recharges are not delayed by Damage

chinese: 你与周围友军施放技能时不消耗魔力
english: Your and nearby allies' Skills Cost no Mana

chinese: 使用近战武器打击敌人，将物理伤害转换为随机的元素伤害。根据转换成的元素释放出猛烈的爆炸、弧动的闪电箭或冰霜波。不会连续两次选择相同的元素。
english: Your melee weapon strikes enemies, converting physical damage to a random element. Then, depending on the element chosen, it releases a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave. It will avoid choosing the same element twice in a row.

chinese: 盾牌破碎，根据盾牌品质，对一片区域内的敌人造成物理法术伤害。之后短时间内你都不能格挡，也不能从盾牌中得到防御值，但你的法术附加物理伤害。
english: Your shield shatters, dealing physical spell damage to enemies in an area, based on the shield's quality. For a short duration after this, you will be unable to block and will gain no defences from your shield, but your spells will deal added physical damage.

chinese: 你的结界猛然破碎，基于当前结界值对范围内敌人造成物理法术伤害。被击中的敌人将陷入衰退状态，移动速度降低20%，并在4秒内无法恢复生命值与能量护盾。
english: Your ward shatters, dealing physical spell damage to enemies in an area, based on the amount of ward you have. Enemies hit are inflicted with Enervation, a Debuff that lowers Movement Speed by 20% and prevents Life and Energy Shield Recovery for 4 seconds.

chinese: 奋锐光环
english: Zealotry
